title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
zh_title: 开源智能体式AI协同科学家用于临床与生物医学发现
summary: OpenScientist开源智能体系统，经领域专家在五项生物医学案例中评估，可在数分钟内完成原本需数月人工分析的任务。
key_points: 开源智能体框架，针对科学家设定的问题生成可验证分析
五项案例含血浆蛋白组生存模型在隐藏队列验证
多发性骨髓瘤假设在外部队列验证，随机对照中信号减弱
reason: 开源智能体系统+多案例专家评估与外部队列验证，属重要档
abstract: Biomedical research is constrained by the time and domain expertise required to analyze increasingly large and complex datasets. Here we present OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist designed to address this gap by investigating scientist-defined queries and generating verifiable, data-grounded analyses. OpenScientist was evaluated by domain experts across five biomedical case studies, completing analyses in minutes that otherwise would take months of human time and expertise. It accurately quantified Alzheimer’s blood biomarker performance, generated a plasma proteomic survival model that predicted survival in a hidden-evaluation cohort, proposed a reproducible mechanism linking tau pathology to altered lysosomal acidification, generated multiple myeloma hypotheses validated in an external cohort with attenuated signal in randomized controls, and demonstrated concordance with an independent human analysis in a blinded, prespecified proteomic comparison. These results support the use of OpenScientist to assist biomedical data analysis in concert with human experts. To support research involving sensitive clinical datasets, OpenScientist can operate in a fully air-gapped environment using open-source models for inference. OpenScientist demonstrates that open, auditable, agentic AI can support real-world clinical research by researching the literature, generating hypotheses, executing analyses, and generating insights from complex datasets.
zh_abstract: 生物医学研究受限于分析日益庞大和复杂数据集所需的时间和领域专业知识。在此，我们介绍 OpenScientist，一个开源智能体 AI 共同科学家（open-source agentic AI co-scientist），旨在通过研究科学家定义的查询并生成可验证、基于数据的分析来弥补这一差距。OpenScientist 由领域专家在五项生物医学案例研究中评估，能在数分钟内完成原本需要数月人力和专业知识才能完成的分析。它准确量化了阿尔茨海默病血液生物标志物性能，生成了血浆蛋白质组生存模型，该模型在隐藏评估队列中预测了生存，提出了将 tau 病理与溶酶体酸化改变联系起来的一种可重复机制，生成了多发性骨髓瘤假设，这些假设在外部队列中得到验证，并在随机化对照中信号减弱，并在盲法、预先设定的蛋白质组比较中证明与独立人工分析一致。这些结果支持使用 OpenScientist 与人类专家协同辅助生物医学数据分析。为支持涉及敏感临床数据集的研究，OpenScientist 可使用开源模型进行推理，在完全气隙隔离环境中运行。OpenScientist 表明，开放、可审计的智能体 AI 可以通过研究文献、生成假设、执行分析和从复杂数据集中产生洞见来支持真实世界临床研究。

title: Deep learning retinal vascular biomarker predicts preeclampsia in a multicenter prospective cohort
zh_title: 深度学习视网膜血管生物标志物预测子痫前期
summary: 多中心前瞻队列8616名孕妇中，融合视网膜照片、临床因素与平均动脉压的模型预测子痫前期，并做外部验证。
key_points: 前瞻性多中心收集8616名孕妇数据
外部验证AUC约0.73–0.82
增益随预测任务而异，部分事件数较少
reason: 同行评审、多中心前瞻队列且有大样本外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Preeclampsia (PE) causes maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, yet noninvasive screening remains limited. We developed Retina-PE, a multimodal deep learning model integrating retinal photographs, maternal clinical factors, and mean arterial pressure to predict subsequent PE. Prospectively collected multicenter data from 8616 pregnant individuals were used for retrospective model development and evaluation. Development-dataset image-level areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) were 0.853 and 0.708 for PE occurrence at 24–28 and 28–32 weeks, 0.871 and 0.791 for 1- and 4-week preterm PE, and 0.979 and 0.862 for 1- and 4-week early-onset PE. Corresponding external-validation-dataset AUCs were 0.728 and 0.815, 0.801 and 0.801, and 0.776 and 0.766. Incremental performance was task-specific. Patient-level analyses showed similar patterns but included few events in some tasks. These findings support prospective evaluation of retinal imaging for maternal risk stratification. Schematic overview of Retina-PE, which combines retinal photographs, maternal clinical factors, and mean arterial pressure through cross-attention fusion. Separate tasks predict subsequent preeclampsia occurrence and early-onset or preterm preeclampsia within one or four weeks. A schematic ROC curve illustrates model evaluation.
zh_abstract: 子痫前期（PE）导致孕产妇和围产期发病和死亡，但无创筛查仍然有限。我们开发了Retina-PE，这是一种多模态深度学习模型，整合视网膜照片、孕产妇临床因素和平均动脉压以预测后续PE。前瞻性收集的来自8616名孕妇的多中心数据用于回顾性模型开发和评估。开发数据集图像水平的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为：24–28周和28–32周发生PE为0.853和0.708，1周和4周早产型PE为0.871和0.791，1周和4周早发型PE为0.979和0.862。相应的外部验证数据集AUC分别为0.728和0.815、0.801和0.801、0.776和0.766。增量性能具有任务特异性。患者水平分析显示相似模式，但某些任务中纳入的事件较少。这些发现支持对视网膜成像用于孕产妇风险分层进行前瞻性评估。Retina-PE的示意性概览，其通过交叉注意力融合结合视网膜照片、孕产妇临床因素和平均动脉压。独立任务预测后续子痫前期的发生以及一周或四周内早发型或早产型子痫前期。示意性ROC曲线展示模型评估。

title: Interpretable AI links routine clinical gout phenotypes to multi-omic signatures and divergent health trajectories
zh_title: 可解释AI联系痛风临床表型与多组学特征及健康轨迹
summary: 基于常规实验室数据构建可解释痛风临床亚型框架，在UKB、中国GoutRe登记与MIMIC-IV共21235人中外部评估。
key_points: UKB 10599人、GoutRe 8617人、MIMIC-IV 2019人
无监督学习识别三种亚型，C2复发风险最高
C3为系统脆弱状态，死亡率更高
reason: 多中心外部验证且样本逾两万，属重要档
abstract: Integrative frameworks that connect scalable clinical phenotypes with molecular mechanisms are needed to resolve disease heterogeneity. We developed and externally evaluated an interpretable gout clinical-subset framework using routine data from 21,235 participants across UK Biobank (UKB; n = 10,599), the multicentre Chinese GoutRe registry ( n = 8617), and MIMIC-IV ( n = 2019). Unsupervised learning on six prespecified routine laboratory variables identified three subsets: C1, a low-burden state with preserved reserve; C2, a urate-metabolic inflammatory state with the greatest recurrence liability and a greater cardiometabolic and hepatic comorbidity burden; and C3, a state characterized by systemic vulnerability and higher mortality. In UKB, death-competing recurrence analysis showed a higher recurrence incidence for C2 versus C1 (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 1.896, 95% CI 1.710–2.101), whereas C3 did not differ from C1 (sHR 0.994, 95% CI 0.887–1.112). A six-variable CRT model reconstructed the locked subset labels using nested 10-fold out-of-fold evaluation in UKB and external application without retraining in GoutRe and MIMIC-IV. One-versus-rest AUCs were 0.965/0.945/0.980 in UKB, 0.906/0.914/0.953 in GoutRe, and 0.912/0.898/0.962 in MIMIC-IV for C1/C2/C3, respectively. Genetic, proteomic, and metabolomic analyses supported distinct urate-inflammatory and systemic-vulnerability axes, although the C3 senescence-related genetic signal was nominal and requires replication. Routine laboratory data can identify gout clinical subsets with distinct molecular profiles and patterns of recurrence and mortality; whether these subsets can guide clinical management requires prospective evaluation.
zh_abstract: 需要连接可扩展临床表型与分子机制的统一框架来解决疾病异质性。我们开发并在外部评估了一个可解释的痛风临床亚组框架，使用来自 UK Biobank（UKB；n = 10,599）、多中心中国 GoutRe 登记库（n = 8617）和 MIMIC-IV（n = 2019）共 21,235 名参与者的常规数据。对六个预先指定的常规实验室变量进行无监督学习，识别出三个亚组：C1，一种储备保留的低负担状态；C2，一种尿酸盐-代谢炎症状态，具有最高的复发风险以及更大的心脏代谢和肝脏合并症负担；C3，一种以全身脆弱性和更高死亡率为特征的状态。在 UKB 中，竞争死亡风险的复发分析显示，C2 相比 C1 的复发发生率更高（亚分布风险比 [sHR] 1.896，95% CI 1.710–2.101），而 C3 与 C1 无差异（sHR 0.994，95% CI 0.887–1.112）。一个六变量 CRT 模型重建了锁定的亚组标签，在 UKB 中使用嵌套 10 折折外评估，并在 GoutRe 和 MIMIC-IV 中未经重新训练进行外部应用。在 UKB、GoutRe 和 MIMIC-IV 中，C1/C2/C3 的一对多 AUC 分别为 0.965/0.945/0.980、0.906/0.914/0.953 和 0.912/0.898/0.962。遗传、蛋白质组和代谢组分析支持不同的尿酸盐-炎症轴和全身脆弱性轴，尽管 C3 的衰老相关遗传信号仅为名义显著，需要重复验证。常规实验室数据可识别具有不同分子谱以及复发和死亡模式的痛风临床亚组；这些亚组能否指导临床管理需要前瞻性评估。

title: STBI: dataset of over 12000 brain CT scans for machine learning in traumatic brain injury
zh_title: STBI：逾1.2万例脑CT创伤性颅脑损伤数据集
summary: npj Digital Medicine发布公开的Shiraz-TBI数据集，含3602例患者、12155次脑CT及结构化标注与结局。
key_points: 3602例患者、12155次连续脑CT、376195幅图像
出血亚型、中线移位、Marshall评分等标注
1259例多模态子集含临床与功能结局
多数变量评分者一致性κ>0.85
reason: 同行评审公开发布的大规模影像数据集，含标注与结局，属重要档
abstract: Publicly available traumatic brain injury (TBI) imaging datasets remain limited by the absence of longitudinal imaging, standardized annotations, and linked clinical outcomes. We developed and validated the Shiraz-TBI (STBI) dataset, a large-scale multimodal resource comprising 3602 patients, 12,155 serial non-contrast brain CT examinations, and 376,195 DICOM images, with all studies additionally available in NIfTI format. Radiologists generated structured annotations for intracranial hemorrhage subtypes, mass effect, midline shift, skull fractures, Marshall CT scores, and other imaging features, while temporal variables and time-to-surgery outcomes were derived. Internal validation by neurosurgeons demonstrated near-perfect inter-rater agreement (κ > 0.85 for most variables). A multimodal subset of 1259 patients includes demographic, clinical, laboratory, treatment, and functional outcome data. By integrating patient-level longitudinal chronologically ordered serial neuroimaging with standardized annotations, temporal information, and prognostic outcomes, STBI provides a publicly available, machine learning-ready resource for imaging analysis, disease progression modeling, prognostic prediction, and clinical decision support in TBI.
zh_abstract: 公开可用的创伤性脑损伤（traumatic brain injury, TBI）影像数据集仍受限于缺乏纵向影像、标准化标注和关联临床结局。我们开发并验证了Shiraz-TBI（STBI）数据集，这是一个大规模多模态资源，包含3602例患者、12,155次连续非增强脑CT检查和376,195幅DICOM图像，所有检查还以NIfTI格式提供。放射科医师针对颅内出血亚型、占位效应、中线移位、颅骨骨折、Marshall CT评分及其他影像特征生成了结构化标注，同时衍生出时间变量和至手术时间结局。由神经外科医师进行的内部验证显示近乎完美的评分者间一致性（多数变量κ > 0.85）。一个包含1259例患者的多模态子集包括人口学、临床、实验室、治疗和功能结局数据。通过整合患者层面的纵向、按时间顺序排列的连续神经影像与标准化标注、时间信息和预后结局，STBI为TBI的影像分析、疾病进展建模、预后预测和临床决策支持提供了一个公开可用、可直接用于机器学习（machine learning-ready）的资源。

title: Interpretable distance-resolved graph learning for cancer gene priority screening
zh_title: 可解释距离分辨图学习用于癌症基因优先筛选
summary: 提出CGMap距离分辨图学习框架，从生物分子网络优先筛选癌症基因候选并追踪机制线索。
key_points: 采用宽度导向并行架构处理分散致癌信号
多拓扑尺度定位基因信号，避免表征同质化
全局扩散模块量化基因协同性
reason: 有新方法且可解释，但条目未给出外部验证或开源信息
abstract: Wang et al. propose CGMap, a distance-resolved graph-learning framework that maps dispersed oncogenic signals into structured priorities, narrowing the cancer gene candidate space and establishing an interpretable path from hypotheses to practical validation. Systematic screening for cancer genes (CGs) is still a central goal in precision oncology, yet integrating sparse and spatially dispersed oncogenic signals to identify testable candidates remains challenging. Here we present CGMap, an interpretable graph-learning framework that uses a width-oriented parallel architecture to prioritize potential CGs from biomolecular networks and trace mechanistic cues. By constructing distance-resolved channels, CGMap localizes spatially dispersed CG signals across multiple topological scales while avoiding representation homogenization. A global diffusion module quantifies gene cooperativity along pathway contexts and yields traceable virtual interactions that map predictions to potential regulatory hypotheses, providing intrinsic interpretability for model decisions. Across multiple biomolecular networks in a pan-cancer setting, CGMap analysed 12,022 genes, consistently outperformed existing methods while remaining computationally efficient and prioritized 70 reliable candidates, including those previously unannotated in established databases. Importantly, the prioritized candidates were associated with the suppression of tumour-related phenotypes, including reduced cell proliferation, migration and invasion, along with a shift of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related features toward a non-mesenchymal state, as supported by parallel loss-of-function assays across cancer and non-malignant cell lines.
zh_abstract: Wang 等人提出 CGMap，一个距离分辨的图学习框架，可将分散的致癌信号映射为结构化优先级，缩小癌症基因候选空间，并建立从假设到实际验证的可解释路径。癌症基因（CGs）的系统性筛查仍是精准肿瘤学的核心目标，但整合稀疏且空间分散的致癌信号以识别可检验候选基因仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 CGMap，一个可解释的图学习框架，它使用面向宽度的并行架构从生物分子网络中优先排序潜在 CGs 并追踪机制线索。通过构建距离分辨通道，CGMap 在多个拓扑尺度上定位空间分散的 CG 信号，同时避免表征同质化。一个全局扩散模块沿通路背景量化基因协同性，并产生可追踪的虚拟相互作用，将预测映射到潜在调控假设，为模型决策提供内在可解释性。在泛癌背景下的多个生物分子网络中，CGMap 分析了 12,022 个基因，始终优于现有方法，同时保持计算高效，并优先排序出 70 个可靠候选基因，包括先前在既有数据库中未注释的候选基因。重要的是，优先排序的候选基因与肿瘤相关表型的抑制相关，包括细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭减少，以及上皮-间充质转化（EMT）相关特征向非间充质状态转变，这些结果得到在癌细胞系和非恶性细胞系中平行开展的功能缺失实验的支持。

title: Image-guided and augmented reality-assisted robotic surgery.
zh_title: 图像引导与AR辅助机器人手术综述
summary: 综述近12–18个月证据：前列腺根治术中AI驱动3D-AR引导的随机试验显示切缘阳性更低、术后放疗更少、12个月控尿更好。
key_points: 随机试验对比3D-AR引导与认知MRI引导
总体切缘阳性更低、术后放疗更少
部分肾切除走向灌注映射与AI自动配准
reason: 综述上限6分，但汇总了报告临床结局的随机试验证据
abstract: [Current opinion in urology] Image-guided and augmented-reality (AR)-assisted robotic surgery is moving from static preoperative visualization toward dynamic, automated navigation. This review summarizes evidence from the past 12-18 months on three-dimensional (3D) virtual models, AR, and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted registration in robotic urology, focusing on which applications have moved to comparative and randomized evidence, and on how far this rationale now generalizes beyond the centers that first described it. In radical prostatectomy, a randomized trial of AI-driven 3D-AR guidance vs. cognitive MRI guidance showed lower overall positive margins, less postoperative radiotherapy, and better 12-month continence. In partial nephrectomy, 3D models have progressed from anatomical planning to perfusion-mapped clamping and automated AI-based registration, with favorable outcomes across comparative, meta-analytic, and propensity-matched series, including in horseshoe kidneys and totally endophytic tumors. Independent European groups have reported automated registration, segmentation, and nephrometry tools, and small series have extended image guidance to kidney transplantation, vena cava thrombectomy, upper tract urothelial carcinoma, and testicular cancer surgery. Randomized evidence in prostatectomy, a maturing pathway in partial nephrectomy, and growing independent replication support an expanding but still procedure-limited role for image-guided robotic surgery. Standardized protocols, objective accuracy metrics, multicenter validation, and structured training remain necessary before wider adoption.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in urology] 图像引导和增强现实（AR）辅助的机器人手术正从静态术前可视化转向动态、自动化导航。本综述总结了过去 12–18 个月关于三维（3D）虚拟模型、AR 和人工智能（AI）辅助配准在机器人泌尿外科中的证据，重点关注哪些应用已进入比较性和随机对照证据，以及这一理念目前在多大程度上推广到最初描述它的中心之外。在根治性前列腺切除术中，一项比较 AI 驱动的 3D-AR 引导与认知性 MRI 引导的随机试验显示，前者总体切缘阳性率更低、术后放疗更少、12 个月控尿功能更好。在部分肾切除术中，3D 模型已从解剖规划进展到灌注映射阻断和基于 AI 的自动配准，在比较性、荟萃分析和倾向匹配系列中均取得良好结局，包括马蹄肾和完全内生性肿瘤。独立的欧洲团队已报道自动配准、分割和肾测量工具，小型系列已将图像引导扩展到肾移植、腔静脉血栓切除术、上尿路尿路上皮癌和睾丸癌手术。前列腺切除术中的随机证据、部分肾切除术中逐渐成熟的路径以及日益增多的独立重复验证，支持图像引导机器人手术的作用不断扩大，但仍受限于特定术式。在更广泛采用之前，标准化方案、客观准确性指标、多中心验证和结构化培训仍然必要。

title: Decoding Complications: Large Language Model-Based Classification of Free-Text Entries in Clinical Stroke Registries.
zh_title: 大模型分类卒中登记自由文本并发症记录
summary: 基于德国卒中登记11216条自由文本，LLM工作流在300条留出集上加权F1达96.5%。
key_points: 18,069例患者中9,146条有效自由文本
GPT-5.4在留出集加权F1为96.5%
本地Qwen 3.5 27B加权F1为90.5%
自由文本较结构化字段多记录19.6%事件
reason: 同行评审、样本量大且以医生共识为参照，但仅单登记内部留出验证
abstract: [Journal of medical systems] Clinical registries capture adverse events (AEs) in free-text fields that are rarely analyzed. We developed a reproducible large language model (LLM)-assisted workflow using 11,216 free-text entries from 18,069 patients in the German Stroke Registry; 9,146 informative entries were retained after filtering. Embedding-based clustering showed poor separation, whereas an LLM-guided taxonomy identified 89 leaf labels. On the model-assisted 1,000-entry development set used for model and prompt selection, GPT-5.4 reached F1 92.4% (95% confidence interval [CI] 91.4-93.4). On 300 held-out entries, weighted F1 against clinician consensus was 96.5% (94.6-98.1) for frozen GPT-5.4 labels and 90.5% (87.5-93.5) for locally run Qwen 3.5 27B. For AE concepts with a comparable structured field, free text documented 1,345 additional instances (+19.6% over 6,867 structured instances); it also documented 7,546 instances of AE concepts without a structured equivalent, most often pneumonia, urinary tract infection and delirium. Beyond baseline covariates and the structured AE count, integrated complication concepts increased the area under the curve for prediction of good functional outcome by 0.025 (95% CI 0.021-0.028) and for death by 0.018 (0.014-0.021); gains were minimal after including the discharge National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) score. On 1,979 public coronary-trial fragments from the Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov (AACT), the software ran end to end, demonstrating its technical applicability to a second clinical text corpus. In conclusion, this workflow enables structured analysis of clinical registry free text and complements structured adverse-event documentation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of medical systems] 临床注册系统在自由文本字段中捕获不良事件（adverse events, AEs），而这些字段很少被分析。我们利用德国卒中登记（German Stroke Registry）中18,069例患者的11,216条自由文本条目，开发了一个可重复的大语言模型（large language model, LLM）辅助工作流程；过滤后保留了9,146条信息性条目。基于嵌入的聚类显示分离效果差，而LLM引导的分类体系识别出89个叶标签。在用于模型和提示选择的模型辅助1,000条条目开发集上，GPT-5.4达到F1 92.4%（95%置信区间[CI] 91.4-93.4）。在300条留出条目上，与临床医师共识相比，冻结GPT-5.4标签的加权F1为96.5%（94.6-98.1），本地运行的Qwen 3.5 27B为90.5%（87.5-93.5）。对于具有可比结构化字段的AE概念，自由文本额外记录了1,345个实例（较6,867个结构化实例增加19.6%）；它还记录了7,546个没有结构化对应字段的AE概念实例，最常见的是肺炎、尿路感染和谵妄。除基线协变量和结构化AE计数外，整合的并发症概念使良好功能结局预测的曲线下面积增加0.025（95% CI 0.021-0.028），使死亡预测增加0.018（0.014-0.021）；在纳入出院时美国国立卫生研究院卒中量表（National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale, NIHSS）评分后，增益极小。在来自ClinicalTrials.gov汇总分析（Aggregate Analysis of ClinicalTrials.gov, AACT）的1,979个公开冠状动脉试验片段上，该软件端到端运行，证明其对第二个临床文本语料库的技术适用性。总之，该工作流程能够对临床注册自由文本进行结构化分析，并补充结构化不良事件记录。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled clinical decision support (CDS) challenges core assumptions of the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) recently updated CDS guidance, including the concepts of independent clinician review of outputs and manufacturer-intended use for exempting certain CDS tools from medical device regulation. We examine the FDA's January 2026 CDS guidance in the context of the evolving landscape of AI-enabled CDS tools, clinician interaction studies with AI-enabled CDS, and AI governance frameworks. Although the FDA's framework distinguishes non-device CDS from regulated software, AI-enabled CDS may synthesize and transform clinical information in ways that are difficult to verify during routine care, increasing clinician susceptibility to automation bias. Incorporating pragmatic triggers into existing governance frameworks can help identify scenarios with a heightened risk for clinical decision influence. Oversight calibrated to real-world clinical decision influence is needed to strengthen practical safety standards for AI-enabled CDS.
zh_abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] 人工智能（AI）赋能的临床决策支持（CDS）挑战了美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）最近更新的CDS指南的核心假设，包括临床医生对输出进行独立审查的概念，以及制造商预期用途可使某些CDS工具豁免于医疗器械监管的概念。我们在AI赋能CDS工具不断演变的格局、临床医生与AI赋能CDS的交互研究以及AI治理框架的背景下，审视FDA 2026年1月的CDS指南。尽管FDA的框架将非器械CDS与受监管软件区分开来，但AI赋能CDS可能以在常规诊疗中难以核实的方式综合和转换临床信息，从而增加临床医生对自动化偏差的易感性。将实用触发因素纳入现有治理框架有助于识别对临床决策影响风险升高的情景。需要与实际临床决策影响相校准的监督，以加强AI赋能CDS的实用安全标准。

title: BioLM-Score: Language-Prior Conditioned Probabilistic Geometric Potentials for Protein-Ligand Scoring.
zh_title: BioLM-Score：语言先验条件化的蛋白-配体打分
summary: 同行评审研究将冻结的蛋白质与分子语言模型嵌入残差-原子距离似然框架，在 DEKOIS 2.0 上测试打分与筛选表现。
key_points: 以门控图卷积融合预训练生物分子表征

abstract: [Bioinformatics (Oxford, England)] Protein-ligand scoring must address affinity prediction, pose selection, and virtual screening, but these objectives are not necessarily optimized together. Geometric likelihood models may generalize poorly when training-set structural coverage is limited. We test whether pretrained biomolecular representations improve scoring under a controlled geometric baseline. BioLM-Score integrates frozen protein and molecular language-model embeddings into a residue-atom distance-likelihood framework via gated graph convolutions. We evaluate geometry-only, jointly trained, and two-stage fine-tuned variants, using the jointly trained variant for the primary controlled comparisons. All three DEKOIS 2.0 screening endpoints improve over the matched geometric baseline with target-level paired support, but affinity scoring and ranking do not improve uniformly. Under a time-split protocol, scoring is significantly lower and ranking is also lower than the geometric baseline, while screening gains persist. On BDB2020+, the difference in affinity correlation between BioLM-Score and GenScore narrows after LP-PDBBind-compatible retraining. Shuffling protein embeddings at inference reduces the screening advantage. However, retrained shuffle controls recover much of the performance, so correct alignment is not established as necessary. BioLM-Score strengthens geometric scoring on screening tasks without retraining the language models. Code, dataset-split identifiers, preprocessing and evaluation scripts, and language-model embedding-generation utilities are available at https://github.com/SZU-ADDG/BioLM-Score. An archival code snapshot and pretrained model weights are available at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878818. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
zh_abstract: [Bioinformatics（Oxford, England）] 蛋白质-配体打分必须处理亲和力预测、构象选择和虚拟筛选，但这些目标未必能一起优化。当训练集结构覆盖有限时，几何似然模型可能泛化较差。我们在受控几何基线下测试预训练生物分子表征是否能改善打分。BioLM-Score 通过门控图卷积，将冻结的蛋白质和分子语言模型嵌入整合到残基—原子距离似然框架中。我们评估仅几何、联合训练和两阶段微调变体，并使用联合训练变体进行主要受控比较。全部三个 DEKOIS 2.0 筛选终点均优于匹配的几何基线，并具有靶标级配对支持，但亲和力打分和排序并非一致改善。在时间划分协议下，打分显著更低，排序也低于几何基线，而筛选增益仍然存在。在 BDB2020+ 上，经 LP-PDBBind 兼容的重新训练后，BioLM-Score 与 GenScore 之间的亲和力相关性差异缩小。在推理时打乱蛋白质嵌入会降低筛选优势。然而，重新训练的随机打乱对照恢复大部分性能，因此正确对齐并未被确立为必要条件。BioLM-Score 在不重新训练语言模型的情况下增强了筛选任务上的几何打分。代码、数据集划分标识符、预处理和评估脚本以及语言模型嵌入生成工具可在 https://github.com/SZU-ADDG/BioLM-Score 获取。存档代码快照和预训练模型权重可在 doi:10.5281/zenodo.21878818 获取。补充数据可在 Bioinformatics 在线获取。

summary: 综述指出多数已获批手术机器人自主级别仍低，条件自主已进入临床，术前临床前自主系统已能学习软组织操作与缝合。

AI引导Aquablation需术者授权已用于临床

reason: 综述类上限6分，信息有一定参考但无新数据
abstract: [Current opinion in urology] Interest in autonomous surgery has intensified as artificial intelligence (AI) has progressed from preoperative applications to intraoperative perception, decision support, and robotic action. This review examines the current state of surgical autonomy and AI integration, with emphasis on urology. Most cleared surgical robots remain at low levels of autonomy, but conditional autonomy has entered clinical practice. In urology, AI-guided Aquablation combines image-based treatment planning with robotic execution under surgeon authorization. In preclinical settings, autonomous systems have progressed from predefined tasks to learned control of soft-tissue manipulation, suturing, and multistep surgical actions. In parallel, surgical AI can recognize operative phases and gestures, assess technical performance, and provide real-time intraoperative decision support, with emerging multimodal and vision-language models further expanding these capabilities. Surgical autonomy remains predominantly task-specific and human-supervised, with more advanced autonomous execution largely confined to preclinical settings. Near-term progress will likely involve increasing integration of conditional-autonomy functions and AI decision support into existing robotic platforms, with the surgeon retaining a central role in supervision and decision-making. Broader clinical adoption will require generalizable models, rigorous validation, and appropriate regulatory and accountability frameworks.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in urology] 随着人工智能（AI）从术前应用进展到术中感知、决策支持和机器人操作，人们对自主手术的兴趣日益增强。本综述审视了手术自主性和 AI 整合的现状，重点在泌尿外科。大多数已获批的手术机器人仍处于较低自主性水平，但条件自主性已进入临床实践。在泌尿外科中，AI 引导的 Aquablation 将基于图像的治疗计划与在外科医生授权下的机器人执行相结合。在临床前环境中，自主系统已从预定义任务进展到对软组织操作、缝合和多步骤手术动作的学习控制。与此同时，手术 AI 能够识别手术阶段和手势、评估技术表现并提供实时术中决策支持，新兴的多模态和视觉-语言模型进一步扩展了这些能力。手术自主性仍然主要是任务特异性和人类监督下的，更高级的自主执行在很大程度上局限于临床前环境。近期进展可能涉及将条件自主功能和 AI 决策支持越来越多地整合到现有机器人平台中，外科医生在监督和决策中保持核心作用。更广泛的临床采用将需要可泛化的模型、严格验证以及适当的监管和问责框架。

title: SLICES: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Self-Supervised Learning on Sparse ICU Time Series
zh_title: SLICES：ICU稀疏时序自监督学习基准
summary: 提出SLICES基准框架，在MIMIC-IV、eICU-CRD及合并队列上以统一临床设置比较ICU时序自监督学习方法。
key_points: 固定24小时数值与观测掩码输入、Transformer编码器、患者级划分
比较掩码自编码、JEPA与对比学习三类目标
MAE在9项冻结分类比较中AUPRC均领先，微调比较中7/9领先
reason: 跨三队列患者级划分的新公开基准，属大规模数据集/基准档
abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) results for intensive care unit (ICU) time series are hard to compare when data processing, encoders, and adaptation vary together. We present SLICES, a benchmark and evaluation framework for comparing and extending SSL methods under a shared clinical setup. It fixes 24-hour value and observation-mask inputs, a Transformer encoder, patient-level splits, four endpoints, two adaptation protocols, and five matched seeds across MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, and their pooled union. Masked autoencoding (MAE), joint-embedding prediction (JEPA), and contrastive learning provide reference implementations. Among these objectives, MAE leads mean AUPRC in all nine frozen classification comparisons, also under converged probes, and in seven of nine fine-tuning comparisons. Fine-tuned MAE leads hospital mortality at full labels and scores higher than a supervised Transformer of the same architecture at every label fraction, and SSL fine-tuning gives the lowest length-of-stay error. Supervised baselines remain strong elsewhere: GRU-D leads 24-hour mortality and XGBoost leads acute kidney injury in all three regimes. Rankings depend on the adaptation protocol, the comparator set, and whether the probe loss matches the metric. A two-seed MIMIC-IV rerun with the maintained code stays within two across-seed SDs of the reference in all 48 downstream runs. The code repository supports new objectives, shared downstream evaluation, and regeneration of the reference results, so new SSL methods can be compared with these references under the same conditions. Generalization to unseen hospitals is not tested here and is the natural next extension.
zh_abstract: 当数据处理、编码器和适配方式一起变化时，重症监护病房（intensive care unit, ICU）时间序列的自监督学习（self-supervised learning, SSL）结果难以比较。我们提出 SLICES，一个用于在共享临床设置下比较和扩展 SSL 方法的基准与评估框架。它固定 24 小时数值和观察掩码输入、一个 Transformer 编码器、患者级划分、四个终点、两种适配协议，以及在 MIMIC-IV、eICU-CRD 及其合并并集上的五个匹配随机种子。掩码自编码（masked autoencoding, MAE）、联合嵌入预测（joint-embedding prediction, JEPA）和对比学习提供参考实现。在这些目标中，MAE 的平均 AUPRC 在全部九项冻结分类比较中最高（在收敛探针下也是如此），并在九项微调比较中的七项领先。微调后的 MAE 在全部标签下在医院死亡率上领先，并在每个标签比例下得分都高于相同架构的监督 Transformer，且 SSL 微调给出最低的住院时长误差。监督基线在其他方面仍然很强：在全部三种方案中，GRU-D 在 24 小时死亡率上领先，XGBoost 在急性肾损伤上领先。排名取决于适配协议、比较器集合以及探针损失是否与指标匹配。使用维护代码进行的双种子 MIMIC-IV 重跑，在全部 48 个下游运行中均处于参考值跨种子标准差的两倍范围内。代码仓库支持新目标、共享下游评估和参考结果的再生，因此新的 SSL 方法可以在相同条件下与这些参考结果进行比较。此处未测试对未见医院的泛化，这是自然的下一步扩展。

title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
zh_title: 支持度门控世界模型的升压药决策支持

abstract: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with recorded actions at 81.0% decision coverage, compared with 55.0% agreement and 99.5% coverage for an ungated ensemble agent. Component ablations show lower factual risk with joint gating than with either gate alone.These results characterize a reliability--coverage trade-off in selective clinical simulation; they do not identify individualized treatment effects or establish improved patient outcomes.
zh_abstract: 临床世界模型让语言模型智能体接触预测的患者反应，但对于支持不足的治疗或不熟悉的医院，模拟可能不可靠。我们引入支持门控世界模型决策支持（Support-Gated World-Model decision support），这是对提议—模拟—细化智能体的轻量级扩展。循环动力学集成预测对记录的去甲肾上腺素剂量类别的短时程生理反应，而行为模型估计观察性动作支持度。接口会扣留支持不足或集成分歧过大的预测，并在没有候选合格时弃权。在 eICU-CRD 上的评估包括 70 家医院和 30,700 个决策转移，其中 14 家医院留出用于测试。在 62.0% 的真实转移覆盖率下，联合门控得到 MAP 平均绝对误差 7.3 mmHg，而相同覆盖率下随机选择为 9.2 mmHg。门控智能体在 81.0% 决策覆盖率下与记录动作达到 60.0% 一致性，而无门控集成智能体为 55.0% 一致性和 99.5% 覆盖率。组件消融显示，联合门控比任一单独门控具有更低的真实风险。这些结果刻画了选择性临床模拟中的可靠性—覆盖率权衡；它们不识别个体化治疗效果，也不确立患者结局改善。

title: Which Model, For Which Variable? Per-Variable Forecast Combination in Sparse ICU Time Series
zh_title: 稀疏ICU时间序列的分变量预测模型组合
summary: 在五个ICU数据库上对94个生理通道做24小时预测，按变量加权组合14个模型，均方误差优于最佳单模型6.1%–11.0%。
key_points: 覆盖MIMIC-III/IV、eICU、HiRID与德国UMM五个库
无单一架构在所有变量上最优
稀疏通道与化验值提升最明显
reason: 五库外部验证且样本通道广，符合外部验证加分，预印本上限内给7分
abstract: Clinical forecasting papers typically report a single best architecture. We show that on multivariate ICU physiology this question conceals variable-specific differences: no architecture is best on every variable, and which model wins changes from variable to variable. Across five ICU databases (MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, eICU, HiRID, and UMM (University Medicine Mannheim), a German single-center ICU) we forecast 94 channels over a 24-hour horizon with a pool of 14 models, and combine them with weights fitted per variable. On test, the combination beats the best single model on all five databases by 6.1-11.0% mean squared error (mean 8.7%). The gain is concentrated where clinical data is thinnest: the sparsest third of channels improves by 11.9% and laboratory values by 7.5%, against 3.1% for the densest third. Rank-based harmonic weighting of the best five models per variable, with no fitted weights at all, recovers about four-fifths of the gain. Extending the pool afterwards with a per-channel gradient-boosted tree, ARIMA and ETS makes the tree the validation-selected best single model on all five databases; per-variable combination still improves on it by 2.9-5.9% (significant on four of five), while equal weighting of the same members does not. As on univariate benchmarks, learned combination beats simple averaging - but only once the weights are constrained. We also report which model to prefer when, and show that the ordering changes with database size.
zh_abstract: 临床预测论文通常报告单一最佳架构。我们表明，在多变量ICU生理数据上，这一问题掩盖了变量特异性差异：没有任何架构在所有变量上都是最佳的，且哪个模型胜出会因变量而异。在五个ICU数据库（MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV、eICU、HiRID和UMM（University Medicine Mannheim，德国单中心ICU））上，我们使用14个模型组成的模型池预测24小时时程内的94个通道，并用按变量拟合的权重对它们进行组合。在测试集上，该组合在全部五个数据库上在均方误差上优于最佳单一模型6.1–11.0%（平均8.7%）。增益集中在临床数据最稀疏之处：最稀疏的三分之一通道改善11.9%，实验室指标改善7.5%，而最密集的三分之一通道仅改善3.1%。对每个变量表现最好的五个模型采用基于秩的调和加权（rank-based harmonic weighting），且完全不拟合权重，可恢复约五分之四的增益。随后将模型池扩展为包含逐通道梯度提升树（gradient-boosted tree）、ARIMA和ETS，使得该树成为全部五个数据库上经验证集选择的最佳单一模型；逐变量组合仍较其提升2.9–5.9%（五个中有四个显著），而对相同成员进行等权平均则没有提升。如同在单变量基准上一样，学习得到的组合优于简单平均——但仅在权重受到约束之后。我们还报告了何时应优先选择哪个模型，并表明这种排序会随数据库规模而变化。

title: Dual chain-of-thought AI‑PDCA framework for clinical history taking and documentation
zh_title: 双链式思维 AI-PDCA 临床问诊与文书训练框架
summary: npj Digital Medicine 发表基于双 CoT 大模型的临床问诊与文书 PDCA 训练框架及回顾性评估。
key_points: 构建临床病例库与 AI 整合的 PDCA 训练框架
采用双链式思维驱动的大语言模型进行评分
回顾性分析 135 名医学生，比较 AI 与教师评分
reason: 单中心小样本回顾性教育研究，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Clinical history-taking and documentation are foundational competencies in undergraduate medical training, yet scalable and individualized training tools remain limited. Large language model (LLM)-based systems provide automated practice opportunities but often lack structured medical reasoning, closed-loop instructional design, and integration into formal curricula. As part of a curriculum reform initiative, we constructed a clinical case repository, developed an artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated faculty Plan–Do–Check–Act (PDCA) training framework supported by dual chain-of-thought (CoT)-driven LLMs, and evaluated the reliability of AI-based scoring against faculty assessment. We then conducted a retrospective observational analysis of routinely collected educational performance data from 135 undergraduate medical students enrolled in one of three existing instructional configurations: traditional instruction, AI-assisted training, or AI + PDCA training. Educational outcomes were assessed using standardized Objective Structured Clinical Examination (OSCE) assessments. The AI + PDCA configuration was associated with the highest OSCE performance in both history-taking and clinical documentation. Among the two AI-supported configurations, longitudinal mixed-effects modeling showed steeper learning trajectories in the AI + PDCA configuration than in the AI-assisted configuration. These findings suggest that integrating AI-derived learning analytics with faculty-guided instructional intervention may support a closed-loop educational model associated with favorable competency acquisition while maintaining human oversight. This framework offers a scalable approach for implementing trustworthy, competency-based AI-enhanced medical education in routine academic practice.
zh_abstract: 临床病史采集与记录是本科医学培训中的基础能力，但可扩展且个体化的培训工具仍然有限。基于大型语言模型（large language model, LLM）的系统提供了自动化练习机会，但往往缺乏结构化的医学推理、闭环教学设计和纳入正式课程。作为课程改革举措的一部分，我们构建了一个临床病例库，开发了一个由双重思维链（chain-of-thought, CoT）驱动的 LLM 支持、人工智能（AI）整合的教师 Plan–Do–Check–Act（PDCA）培训框架，并以教师评估为参照评估了基于 AI 的评分的可靠性。随后，我们对 135 名本科医学生常规收集的教育表现数据进行了回顾性观察性分析，这些学生接受三种现有教学配置之一：传统教学、AI 辅助培训或 AI + PDCA 培训。教育结局使用标准化客观结构化临床考试（Objective Structured Clinical Examination, OSCE）评估。AI + PDCA 配置在病史采集和临床记录两方面均与最高的 OSCE 表现相关。在两种 AI 支持配置中，纵向混合效应模型显示 AI + PDCA 配置的学习轨迹比 AI 辅助配置更陡峭。这些发现提示，将 AI 衍生的学习分析与教师引导的教学干预相结合，可能支持一种闭环教育模式，该模式在保持人工监督的同时与良好的能力习得相关。该框架为在日常学术实践中实施可信、基于能力的 AI 增强医学教育提供了一种可扩展的方法。

title: Machine learning for small-molecule antibiotics - discovery to pre-clinical optimization.
source: PubMed · Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases
zh_title: 机器学习加速小分子抗生素发现与临床前优化
summary: 综述梳理机器学习在小分子抗生素从发现到临床前优化中的应用，并指出抗菌药物研发管线薄弱与经济激励不足。
key_points: 2021年耐药相关死亡471万，归因死亡114万
预计2050年归因死亡升至每年191万
机器学习被视为有前景但尚未验证的工具
reason: 综述类最高6分档；主题重要但无原始数据，取5分。
abstract: [Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases] The rapid rise of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) poses a critical global health crisis, with 4.71 million associated deaths and 1.14 million attributable deaths in 2021. By 2050, these tolls are forecasted to rise to 8.22 million associated deaths and 1.91 million attributable deaths annually. Despite this growing burden, the antibacterial pipeline is alarmingly lean, with few candidates exhibiting truly novel mechanisms of action (MOA). This innovation gap is worsened by the lack of economic incentives for large pharmaceutical companies to develop new antibiotics, placing increasing pressure on academic laboratories and small biotechnology companies. Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising, albeit unproven, toolset to accelerate and reduce the cost of antibiotic discovery and development. To review a cross-section of ML methods and their applications across the preclinical antibiotic discovery and development pipeline. Google Scholar and PubMed were searched through June 2026, combining terms for machine learning, deep learning, and artificial intelligence with antibiotic discovery and development, virtual screening, generative molecular design, and ADMET prediction. Primary research articles were prioritized, with preprints from arXiv and bioRxiv included where no peer-reviewed version was available. Reference lists of retrieved articles and WHO antibacterial pipeline reports were also screened. ML approaches enable more efficient exploration of vast chemical spaces in silico, facilitating the discovery of structurally novel antibacterial compounds in phenotype- and target-based applications. Both discriminative and generative models have demonstrated success in discovering new scaffolds and in multi-property optimization tasks. In target-based discovery, ML-guided docking strategies have improved scalability relative to more computationally demanding physics-based methods. ML-guided methods can improve the efficiency, scalability, and success rate of antibiotic discovery and development programs. However, the implementation of these models will require high-quality training data and rigorous experimental validation prior to end-to-end integration.
zh_abstract: [Clinical Microbiology and Infection：欧洲临床微生物学与感染病学会官方出版物] 抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）的迅速上升构成严重的全球健康危机，2021年有471万相关死亡和114万归因死亡。到2050年，预计这些数字将每年升至822万相关死亡和191万归因死亡。尽管负担日益加重，抗菌药物研发管线却令人担忧地单薄，很少有候选药物表现出真正新颖的作用机制（MOA）。大型制药公司缺乏开发新抗生素的经济激励，加剧了这一创新缺口，并给学术实验室和小型生物技术公司带来越来越大的压力。机器学习（ML）已成为一种有前景但尚未经验证的工具集，用于加速抗生素发现与开发并降低其成本。旨在综述机器学习方法及其在临床前抗生素发现与开发管线中应用的横断面情况。检索了 Google Scholar 和 PubMed，截止至2026年6月，将机器学习、深度学习和人工智能相关术语与抗生素发现与开发、虚拟筛选、生成式分子设计和 ADMET 预测相关术语组合检索。优先纳入原始研究论文；在无同行评议版本可用时，纳入来自 arXiv 和 bioRxiv 的预印本。还筛选了所检索文章的参考文献列表以及 WHO 抗菌药物研发管线报告。机器学习方法能够在计算机中更高效地探索广阔化学空间，促进在基于表型和基于靶点的应用中发现结构新颖的抗菌化合物。判别式和生成式模型均已在发现新骨架和多属性优化任务中展示出成功。在基于靶点的发现中，机器学习引导的对接策略相对于计算需求更高的基于物理的方法提高了可扩展性。机器学习引导的方法可以提高抗生素发现与开发项目的效率、可扩展性和成功率。然而，这些模型的实施将需要高质量训练数据，并在端到端整合之前进行严格的实验验证。

title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
zh_title: 分子相互作用基础模型涌现生物学能力
summary: 预印本提出Bonbon模型，基于约3.2万亿token蛋白-配体序列训练，展现三类零样本涌现能力。
key_points: 覆盖功能、残基、键三级分辨率的零样本能力
可区分正构与别构位点、共价与非共价结合
能力可泛化至分布外复合物，含6种规模缩放实验
reason: 方法新颖且有缩放对照，但为未经同行评审的预印本
abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.
zh_abstract: 在大型无标注语料上训练的基础模型会发展出涌现能力，即超越训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出 Bonbon，这是一种分子相互作用基础模型，基于约 3.2 万亿个配对的蛋白质-配体序列 token 训练。Bonbon 从单一表示空间展现出三个层级分辨率上的零样本涌现能力：功能层面（作用机制）、残基层面（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构区分）和键层面（共价与非共价结合）。这三种能力均能泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon 仅基于蛋白质-配体序列训练，没有任何任务特定监督，也没有结构坐标。我们在从 42M 到 1.6B 参数的六个模型规模上进行了受控缩放实验；在连续指标上，所评估的每种能力均在最大规模处出现急剧跃升，即便预训练损失平滑下降。这表明，仅凭基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时可用。由于配对生物相互作用数据稀疏，这里报告的能力是在以 1:2,000 的参数与 token 比例训练后出现的。相同的冻结表示实现了最先进的结合和亲和力预测，速度比共折叠方法快五个数量级。在跨七个蛋白质家族的九个疾病靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证中，Bonbon 在从头化合物上达到 61.5% 的剂量反应命中率，产生了此前未报告可抑制这些蛋白质的结构新颖分子，包括针对分布外靶点。

title: Governing Clinical AI Deployment: A Mathematical Framework for Transparency-Dependent Autonomy.
zh_title: 临床AI部署治理：依赖透明度的自主性框架
summary: 提出由置信度、解释质量与指南一致性构成的信任分及自适应阈值，在MIMIC与eICU队列回顾性评估。
key_points: 自适应阈值τ(E)=θ0+κ(1-E)
在MIMIC-IV、eICU约200家医院等队列评估
reason: 跨MIMIC-III/IV与eICU约200家医院数据外部评估，但为回顾性规则验证，未报告临床结局
abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Healthcare institutions lack explicit, quantitative rules for deciding when a clinical artificial intelligence (AI) system may act without human review. Objective: To formalize and retrospectively evaluate a transparency-dependent deployment rule. Methods: A trust score, T = 0.60C + 0.24E + 0.16S, combines calibrated confidence in the predicted class (C), explanation quality (E), and guideline alignment (S) and is compared with an adaptive threshold, τ(E) = θ0 + κ(1 - E); equivalently, a prediction is deployed when 0.60C + 0.44E + 0.16S ≥ 0.70. We evaluated the rule in 5000 MIMIC-IV intensive care unit patients, 5000 eICU patients from about 200 hospitals, and a MIMIC-III cohort, against confidence-only and random deferral at matched coverage, and tested a confidence threshold with a finite-sample guarantee on the error rate among deployed predictions. Results: In MIMIC-IV, areas under the curve were 0.77-0.81 (prolonged stay) and 0.83-0.88 (mortality). Within each model, the rule's decisions matched deferral of the least-confident cases by C alone (99.4-100% agreement); E and S acted as model-level offsets, and re-optimized weights selected confidence alone. Computational E was not correlated with physician-rated utility (r = -0.15). The guaranteed threshold certified an error rate of at most 10% for 86-97% of mortality predictions but, for the primary prolonged-stay model, deployed on average only 15% of predictions at a 20% error budget, whereas the default rule deployed 77% with no error guarantee. Conclusions: Transparency is better suited to setting system-level error budgets than per-case thresholds; per case, autonomous deployment should rest on calibrated confidence with a certified error guarantee.
zh_abstract: 【医疗保健（Basel, Switzerland）】【背景】医疗机构缺乏明确的定量规则来决定临床人工智能（AI）系统何时可在无人工审核的情况下行动。【目的】形式化并回顾性评估一种依赖透明度的部署规则。【方法】信任评分 T = 0.60C + 0.24E + 0.16S 结合了对预测类别校准后的置信度（C）、解释质量（E）和指南一致性（S），并与自适应阈值 τ(E) = θ0 + κ(1 - E) 进行比较；等价地，当 0.60C + 0.44E + 0.16S ≥ 0.70 时部署预测。我们在5000名MIMIC-IV重症监护病房患者、来自约200家医院的5000名eICU患者以及一个MIMIC-III队列中评估该规则，在匹配覆盖率下与仅使用置信度和随机推迟进行比较，并测试了一种对已部署预测中的错误率具有有限样本保证的置信度阈值。【结果】在MIMIC-IV中，曲线下面积分别为0.77-0.81（住院时间延长）和0.83-0.88（死亡率）。在每个模型内，该规则的决策与仅根据C推迟置信度最低病例相匹配（一致率99.4-100%）；E和S充当模型层面的偏移，重新优化权重后仅选择置信度。计算得到的E与医生评定的效用不相关（r = -0.15）。有保证的阈值在86-97%的死亡率预测中证明错误率至多为10%，但对于主要的住院时间延长模型，在20%错误预算下平均仅部署15%的预测，而默认规则部署了77%且无错误保证。【结论】透明度更适合用于设定系统层面的错误预算，而非逐例阈值；就逐例而言，自主部署应基于具有经认证错误保证的校准置信度。

title: Viro-BERT: Whole-Genome Attention for Robust Viral Pathogen Classification from Next-Generation Sequencing Data.
zh_title: Viro-BERT：全基因组注意力用于病毒病原体分类
summary: 将完整基因组切成重叠窗口、用共享DistilBERT编码并做晚期融合，改善NGS数据的病毒病原体分类。
key_points: 针对只读取基因组起始窗口的「截断盲区」
重叠512 token窗口+共享DistilBERT编码
与1D-CNN、双向LSTM等基线比较
reason: 同行评审新方法且有基线对比，但未见外部验证与样本规模，属值得一看档
abstract: [Virus research] Classifying viral pathogens from next-generation sequencing (NGS) data is central to diagnosis and genomic surveillance. Most deep learning classifiers, however, read only a fixed window at the start of each genome, typically a few hundred to a few thousand base pairs, and so ignore more than 95% of the sequence of large DNA viruses such as monkeypox virus (MPV) and herpes simplex virus 1 (HSV-1). We refer to this problem as Truncation Blindness. Here we present Viro-BERT, which splits a complete genome into overlapping 512-token windows, encodes each window with a shared DistilBERT encoder, and averages the window-level class probabilities in a Late Fusion Consensus layer. Because the windows are processed independently, memory use does not grow with genome length. We compared Viro-BERT with one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN), bidirectional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) and RoBERTa baselines on 14 viral classes, using the same segmentation and training protocol for all models. Viro-BERT reached 96.79% accuracy and a macro-F1 score of 96.17%. We then added random substitution noise to the test genomes. At 5% noise, the accuracy of the 1D-CNN fell by 5.57 percentage points, whereas Viro-BERT still classified 93.68% of genomes correctly. Positional and attention analyses on HSV-1 showed that Viro-BERT uses diagnostic signal from across the genome rather than from its 5' end alone. These results indicate that whole-genome context is needed for viral classifiers that remain reliable on noisy clinical data.
zh_abstract: 【病毒研究】从下一代测序（NGS）数据中对病毒病原体进行分类，是诊断和基因组监测的核心。然而，大多数深度学习分类器只读取每个基因组起始处的一个固定窗口，通常为几百到几千个碱基对，因而忽略了大DNA病毒（如猴痘病毒（MPV）和单纯疱疹病毒1型（HSV-1））超过95%的序列。我们将这一问题称为截断盲区（Truncation Blindness）。在此我们提出Viro-BERT，它将完整基因组拆分为相互重叠的512个token窗口，用共享的DistilBERT编码器对每个窗口进行编码，并在晚期融合共识（Late Fusion Consensus）层中对窗口级类别概率取平均。由于各窗口独立处理，内存使用不随基因组长度增长。我们在14个病毒类别上，将Viro-BERT与一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）、双向长短期记忆网络（Bi-LSTM）和RoBERTa基线进行比较，所有模型使用相同的分段和训练方案。Viro-BERT达到96.79%的准确率和96.17%的宏F1分数（macro-F1）。随后我们向测试基因组加入随机替换噪声。在5%噪声下，1D-CNN的准确率下降5.57个百分点，而Viro-BERT仍能正确分类93.68%的基因组。对HSV-1的位置和注意力分析表明，Viro-BERT使用的是来自整个基因组的诊断信号，而非仅来自其5'端。这些结果表明，要在噪声临床数据上保持可靠的病毒分类器需要全基因组背景。

title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
zh_title: 决策模型能否从癌症病理报告中抽取临床数据
summary: 在单中心1113份口腔癌病理报告上评估两种决策模型抽取25个字段的准确性、校准与失败模式，并与生成模型对比。
key_points: 单中心1113份口腔癌病理报告
Tev1字段准确率0.917，速度约为生成模型4倍
决策模型在分箱测量值类别上表现较弱
reason: 设计规范的模型评测、样本逾千，但单中心无外部验证
abstract: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not reported, and on some complex decisions (e.g. involved margins). We found that the main cause of the inferior performance of Nimble's came from asking 25 questions in one request: with two questions per request, its accuracy improved. Pooled over fields, the returned probabilities were well calibrated (expected calibration error 0.022 and 0.026), but they did not flag systematic errors within single fields. A simulated strategy of sending answers with a probability below 0.94 to GLM-5.3-flash raised Tev1's accuracy to 0.982, with 38% of answers escalated. Decision models can extract explicitly stated findings from pathology reports quickly on local hardware and return useful probabilities. They should be validated in the configuration in which they will be used, restricted to the fields in which they are reliable, and combined with other methods for numeric values.
zh_abstract: 决策模型是一类新型语言模型，其不生成文本，而是从固定列表中为每个问题选择一个选项，并返回每个选项的概率。它们尚未在临床文本上接受评估。我们评估了两个开放权重决策模型 Nimble 9B 和 Tev1 4B，从单中心的 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段，并与前瞻性维护的临床数据库进行对照。我们将它们与两个生成模型进行比较：本地运行的 Qwen3.5 9B 和通过云 API 运行的 GLM-5.3-flash。Tev1 达到平均字段准确率 0.917（95% CI 0.913 至 0.920），与 Qwen3.5 9B 相同（0.918；p = 0.26），并且速度快四倍（每份报告 15 秒对 61 秒）。Nimble 达到 0.862，GLM-5.3-flash 达到 0.986。两个决策模型在简单的二分类类别上与 GLM-5.3-flash 相当。它们在分箱为类别的测量值、正确答案未报告的字段以及一些复杂决策（例如切缘受累）上表现较弱。我们发现 Nimble 表现较差的主要原因来自在一个请求中询问 25 个问题：当每个请求包含两个问题时，其准确率有所提高。在所有字段上汇总时，返回的概率校准良好（期望校准误差 0.022 和 0.026），但它们未能标记单个字段内的系统性错误。一种模拟策略是将概率低于 0.94 的答案发送给 GLM-5.3-flash，这将 Tev1 的准确率提高到 0.982，其中 38% 的答案被升级处理。决策模型可以在本地硬件上快速从病理报告中提取明确陈述的发现，并返回有用的概率。它们应在实际使用的配置中接受验证，限制在其可靠的字段内，并与其他方法结合用于数值。

title: Who Benefits from Telemonitoring? Uplift Modelling of a Nationwide Home Blood Pressure Monitoring Programme
zh_title: 远程血压监测获益人群的uplift建模
summary: 基于新加坡全国远程血压监测项目16694例回顾数据及倾向评分匹配对照，6个月血压控制率提高5个百分点，基线未控制者提高12个百分点。
key_points: 血压控制率74%对69%，绝对提高5个百分点
基线未控制者63%对50%，提高12个百分点
reason: 全国级大样本并报告血压控制结局，但为回顾性设计、无前瞻验证
abstract: Home blood pressure (BP) telemonitoring programmes are being deployed at national scale, yet enrolment resources are finite and the benefit of telemonitoring is unlikely to be uniform across patients. We study the Primary Technology-Enhanced Care for Hypertension (PTEC-HT) programme, a nationwide telemonitoring programme for hypertensive patients in Singapore. Using retrospective data on 16,694 patients registered between August 2020 and May 2024, we first estimate the average treatment effect of the programme on 6-month BP control against a propensity-score-matched non-participant cohort, finding an absolute improvement of 5 percentage points in the rate of BP control (74% vs. 69%, $p = 3\times10^{-12}$), rising to 12 percentage points (63% vs. 50%, $p = 1\times10^{-15}$) among patients with uncontrolled BP at baseline. We then move beyond the average effect and apply uplift modelling to estimate individual treatment effects. Across five uplift learners evaluated with 5-fold cross-validation and Qini curves, an uplift random forest performed best on the full cohort and an S-learner on the uncontrolled-baseline subcohort, although performance bands overlapped across learners. On held-out patients, realised uplift was largest in the top predicted-uplift groups and declined across the ranking. These patients had higher baseline BP grade, more recent hypertension diagnosis and lower medication and diagnosis burden, a profile we offer as hypothesis-generating for targeted enrolment. A handcrafted rule built from these features was competitive with the learned models, outperforming all of them on the uncontrolled-baseline cohort, suggesting that uplift models are useful for discovering heterogeneity that can be distilled into simple enrolment criteria for directing limited care team capacity.
zh_abstract: 家庭血压（blood pressure, BP）远程监测项目正在全国范围内部署，但入组资源有限，且远程监测的获益在不同患者之间不太可能一致。我们研究高血压初级技术增强照护（Primary Technology-Enhanced Care for Hypertension, PTEC-HT）项目，这是新加坡一项面向高血压患者的全国性远程监测项目。利用2020年8月至2024年5月期间登记的16,694名患者的回顾性数据，我们首先以倾向评分匹配的非参与者队列为对照，估计该项目对6个月血压控制的平均处理效应，发现血压控制率绝对改善5个百分点（74% vs. 69%，p = 3×10^{-12}），在基线血压未控制的患者中升至12个百分点（63% vs. 50%，p = 1×10^{-15}）。随后，我们超越平均效应，应用增益建模（uplift modelling）估计个体处理效应。在使用5折交叉验证和Qini曲线评估的五种增益学习器中，增益随机森林（uplift random forest）在全队列上表现最佳，S学习器（S-learner）在基线未控制亚队列上表现最佳，尽管各学习器的性能区间存在重叠。在留出患者中，实际实现的增益在预测增益最高的组中最大，并沿排名下降。这些患者具有更高的基线血压分级、更近期的高血压诊断以及更低的用药和诊断负担，我们将该特征轮廓作为用于靶向入组的假设生成依据。基于这些特征构建的手工规则与学习模型具有竞争力，并在基线未控制队列上优于所有学习模型，提示增益模型有助于发现可被提炼为简单入组标准的异质性，以引导有限的照护团队能力。

title: Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records
zh_title: 证据条件下的电子病历补全与合成
summary: 预印本提出EHRDiB，用证据条件潜在扩散桥统一病历补全与合成，在MIMIC-IV与Duke Health评估。
key_points: 区分原始缺失与人为扣留输入
补全比较八项中七项效用差距最小
合成任务报告隐私泄露风险
reason: 多数据集对比充分的新方法预印本，未经同行评审
abstract: Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.
zh_abstract: 患者信息可指导电子健康记录（EHR）生成，但其数量如何影响预测效用和披露风险仍缺乏充分表征。在此，我们提出 EHRDiB，它通过区分原始缺失与被扣留的输入，并将共享多模态表示与证据条件化潜在扩散桥结合，统一了就诊补全与合成。我们在 MIMIC-IV 以及数值化和离散化的 Duke Health 表示上，将 EHRDiB 与三种补全方法和八种合成方法进行比较。评估涵盖两项任务的下游预测效用、生成多样性和分布保真度，以及合成任务的披露风险。在八项补全比较中的七项中，EHRDiB 相对于真实数据训练的分类器取得了最小的效用差距。在合成中，相对于最佳对照方法，十个 MIMIC-IV 主要诊断目标的 AUPRC 差距缩小了 45.2%，数值化 Duke Health 数据的 AUPRC 差距缩小了 53.3%。采用校准阈值化的合成在全部三个数据集上产生了最低的边际分布误差，两种输出规则的 Coverage 均高于 0.95。在 MIMIC-IV 合成的十二个证据比例区间中，随着平均目标证据比例从 0.20 升至 0.50，成员推断 AUROC 从 0.516 增至 0.598；相对于最低证据配置，效用差距缩小，但并未单调下降。我们的研究为 EHR 生成提供了一个统一框架和实证基础，该框架同时考虑其临床分析效用和信息披露风险。

title: Clinician Assessment of Laryngeal Disease with Auditory AI before Laryngoscopy: A Paired Reader Study
zh_title: 喉镜前用听觉AI评估喉部疾病：配对阅片者研究
summary: 单中心开发基于语音的听觉大模型生成评估卡，32名耳鼻喉科医生阅片准确率由49.8%升至56.8%。
key_points: 输出含临时分类、音质评分与理由，并附恶性预警
共800组配对评估，另设留出测试集与后续队列
属单中心预印本，尚需外部验证
reason: 有医生对照的读者研究但单中心、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Before laryngoscopy, clinicians assess the likely cause of hoarseness and whether to suspect a precancerous or malignant lesion. Whether voice-based artificial intelligence (AI) supports pre-laryngoscopic categorization is unknown. Methods: We developed an auditory large language model that generates a patient-level assessment card (provisional category, voice-quality ratings, and rationale) and a prespecified malignancy alert from voice recordings, patient information, and acoustic measures obtained before laryngoscopy at one center. We evaluated both in a held-out test set and a later cohort. In a sequential reader study, 32 otolaryngology clinicians categorized held-out cases without AI and, 1 to 2 weeks later, reviewed their initial categories with the card (without the alert). Results: Across 800 paired assessments, reader accuracy was 49.8% before and 56.8% after review (difference, 7.0 percentage points; 95% CI, 1.7 to 13.5; P < 0.001); 99 categories changed from incorrect to correct and 43 from correct to incorrect (ratio, 2.30; 95% CI, 1.22 to 5.31). Accuracy rose 14.7 points when the model was correct and fell 8.7 when incorrect. Provisional-category accuracy was 72% in held-out testing and 67% in temporal validation. The malignancy alert flagged 85.7% and 86.8% of precancerous or malignant lesions. Sensitivity for precancerous or malignant lesions increased from 53.9% to 75.0% after AI-assisted review (difference, 21.1 percentage points; 95% CI, 4.3 to 42.0). Conclusions: In this single-center study, clinicians' pre-laryngoscopic categorization accuracy was higher after reviewing the AI assessment card, although the sequential design cannot fully separate AI assistance from reassessment; gains depended on model correctness without clearly selective adoption. Randomized and external evaluations, including of the malignancy alert, are needed.
zh_abstract: 【背景】在喉镜检查前，临床医生会评估声音嘶哑的可能原因，以及是否应怀疑癌前或恶性病变。基于语音的人工智能（AI）是否支持喉镜检查前分类尚不清楚。【方法】我们开发了一种听觉大语言模型，该模型基于在一个中心喉镜检查前获取的录音、患者信息和声学测量，生成患者层面的评估卡（暂定类别、音质评分和理由）以及预设的恶性肿瘤警报。我们在一个留出测试集和一个随后队列中评估了二者。在一项序贯阅片者研究中，32名耳鼻咽喉科临床医生在没有AI的情况下对留出病例进行分类，并在1至2周后借助评估卡（不含警报）复核其初始分类。【结果】在800次配对评估中，阅片者准确率在复核前为49.8%，复核后为56.8%（差值7.0个百分点；95% CI 1.7至13.5；P < 0.001）；99个分类由错误变为正确，43个由正确变为错误（比值2.30；95% CI 1.22至5.31）。当模型正确时准确率上升14.7个百分点，当模型错误时下降8.7个百分点。暂定类别准确率在留出测试中为72%，在时间验证中为67%。恶性肿瘤警报分别标记了85.7%和86.8%的癌前或恶性病变。对癌前或恶性病变的敏感性在AI辅助复核后从53.9%升至75.0%（差值21.1个百分点；95% CI 4.3至42.0）。【结论】在这项单中心研究中，临床医生在复核AI评估卡后喉镜检查前分类准确率更高，尽管序贯设计无法完全区分AI辅助与重新评估；获益取决于模型是否正确，且未见明确的选择性采纳。需要随机化和外部评估，包括对恶性肿瘤警报的评估。

title: HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity
zh_title: HEmIF-Bench：超越虚拟染色保真度的H&E转mIF评测
summary: 预印本提出评测框架，用8个数据集、5个冻结生成器，从细胞、组织到患者层面检验H&E转mIF模型的下游用途。
key_points: 涵盖8个数据集与5个冻结生成模型
评测CD3恢复、单细胞分类、核分割、TLS/GC分割
另评估患者生存预测，参照病理基础模型UNI2
reason: 多数据集基准、下游任务设计有新意，但为预印本，属值得一看档。
abstract: Hematoxylin and eosin (H&E)-to-multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) generators predict spatial protein expression from routine histology, yet pixel-level marker reconstruction does not establish downstream utility. We present HEmIF-Bench, evaluating five frozen generators across eight datasets spanning molecular, cellular, tissue, and patient scales. HEmIF-Bench decouples internal encoder features from generated outputs, benchmarking both against the pathology foundation reference UNI2. Mirroring the clinical workflow where pathologists rely on mIF to define cell phenotypes, delineate tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) and germinal centers (GCs), and stratify patient risk, we evaluate external CD3 recovery, single-cell classification, dense nuclear segmentation, TLS/GC segmentation, and patient survival prediction. Across the benchmark, foundation-model-based MIPHEI-ViT leads among the generators, while non-foundation models show task-specific strengths. Comparing the two routes reveals that internal encoder features generally outperform generated outputs, and larger output marker panels do not guarantee stronger downstream utility across datasets. Moreover, neither internal encoder features nor generated outputs consistently surpass frozen UNI2. These findings show that pixel-level stain fidelity does not equate to downstream utility, and that generators trained at current paired-data scales have yet to surpass large-scale pure-H&E foundation models. With the expansion of paired translation cohorts and the advancement of foundation-based generative architectures, HEmIF-Bench establishes a definitive benchmark for tracking when H&E-to-mIF generation crosses the threshold to deliver genuine value beyond routine histology for tumor microenvironment analysis and precision oncology.
zh_abstract: 苏木精-伊红（H&E）到多重免疫荧光（mIF）生成器可从常规组织学预测空间蛋白表达，但像素级标记重建并不能确立下游效用。我们提出 HEmIF-Bench（HEmIF-Bench），在涵盖分子、细胞、组织和患者尺度的八个数据集上评估五种冻结生成器。HEmIF-Bench 将内部编码器特征与生成输出解耦，并将二者与病理基础模型参考 UNI2（UNI2）进行基准比较。为模拟临床工作流程——病理学家依赖 mIF 定义细胞表型、勾画三级淋巴结构（TLSs）和生发中心（GCs）并对患者风险分层——我们评估外部 CD3 恢复、单细胞分类、密集细胞核分割、TLS/GC 分割和患者生存预测。在整个基准中，基于基础模型的 MIPHEI-ViT 在生成器中领先，而非基础模型表现出任务特异性优势。比较两条路径表明，内部编码器特征通常优于生成输出，且更大的输出标记面板并不能保证在不同数据集上具有更强的下游效用。此外，无论是内部编码器特征还是生成输出，均未持续超越冻结的 UNI2。这些发现表明，像素级染色保真度并不等同于下游效用，并且在当前配对数据规模下训练的生成器尚未超越大规模纯 H&E 基础模型。随着配对翻译队列的扩展和基于基础模型的生成架构的进步，HEmIF-Bench 建立了一个明确的基准，用于追踪 H&E 到 mIF 生成何时跨过阈值，从而在肿瘤微环境分析和精准肿瘤学中提供超越常规组织学的真正价值。

title: ROUNDS: Source-Framed Diagnostic Revision after Multi-Turn Clinical Evidence
zh_title: ROUNDS：多轮临床证据下的诊断修正评测
summary: 构建多轮对话诊断评测框架，覆盖7个模型、5个数据集共1035例，检验模型对后续证据与他人意见的修正能力。
key_points: 7个模型、5个数据集、1035例病例
比较有无答案选项下的诊断准确率
设置临床医生与普通人框架的五人小组意见
reason: 预印本，多数据集多模型基准评测有方法新意，但未经同行评审、非真实临床结局
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve high scores on medical benchmarks, but does this performance translate into reliable diagnosis as a conversation unfolds? In diagnostic conversations, users can provide clinical findings across multiple turns, ask for a diagnosis without supplying answer options, and introduce opinions from others. Models must therefore form diagnoses from the available evidence and decide how to respond to subsequent advice. We introduce ROUNDS, a framework that evaluates these abilities after a fixed sequence of clinical evidence delivered over multiple turns. ROUNDS compares diagnosis with and without answer options, presents the same incorrect diagnosis under clinician and lay framing, and varies support for competing diagnoses in written five-clinician panels. Across seven models and 1,035 cases from five datasets, average accuracy was 76.9% with answer options and 57.0% without them. Clinician-framed misleading advice produced lower final accuracy than lay-framed advice in every model, with differences of 4.6 to 38.2 percentage points. Initially correct diagnoses more often became incorrect answers than abstentions, and many adopted the suggested disease. Conversely, accuracy increased as more panel members supported the correct diagnosis, including when the majority opinion remained unchanged. These findings reveal a gap between medical benchmark performance and reliable diagnosis in conversation: models respond to external opinions, but remain vulnerable to abandoning correct diagnoses without new clinical evidence.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在医学基准测试中取得高分，但这种表现能否在对话逐步展开时转化为可靠诊断？在诊断对话中，用户可以在多个轮次中提供临床发现，在不提供答案选项的情况下要求给出诊断，并引入他人的意见。因此，模型必须根据现有证据形成诊断，并决定如何回应后续建议。我们提出ROUNDS，一个在通过多个轮次传递固定序列临床证据后评估这些能力的框架。ROUNDS比较有答案选项和无答案选项时的诊断，在临床医生框架和外行框架下呈现相同的不正确诊断，并在书面的五名临床医生专家组中改变对竞争性诊断的支持程度。在来自五个数据集的1,035个病例和七个模型中，有答案选项时的平均准确率为76.9%，无答案选项时为57.0%。以临床医生框架表述的误导性建议在每个模型中都比以外行框架表述的建议导致更低的最终准确率，差异为4.6至38.2个百分点。最初正确的诊断比弃答更常变为错误答案，且许多采用了所建议的疾病。相反，随着更多专家组成员支持正确诊断，准确率上升，包括多数意见保持不变时也是如此。这些发现揭示了医学基准表现与对话中可靠诊断之间的差距：模型会对外部意见作出反应，但仍容易在没有新的临床证据时放弃正确诊断。

title: Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions
zh_title: 病理基础模型在非典型乳腺病变上的分类失效
summary: 用四个病理基础模型在BRACS上交叉验证，发现带标注的ADH切片中仅39%被标为ADH，模型对非典型病变判断最差。
key_points: 四个病理基础模型在非典型乳腺病变上表现最差
仅39%含ADH标注的切片被标为ADH
按决策训练、用病变级标签可改善四个非典型边界
reason: 预印本，交叉验证含外部医院与HISTAI数据，但无前瞻性设计与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. In a hospital with pathologist-labelled single-subtype slides and in HISTAI, benign slides were scored closer to lesions and triage specificity fell from 0.48-0.53 to 0.00-0.07 and 0.22.
zh_abstract: 乳腺导管病变被称为非典型增生还是低级别原位癌，越来越决定手术决策。然而，基于病理基础模型（PFM）构建的切片级分类器在这些病变上表现最差。我们使用四种PFM、在BRACS上的交叉验证和预先注册的假设，研究了非典型增生的分类在何处失败。由于切片按其最严重病变标注，在注释有非典型导管增生（ADH）的切片中，仅39%被标注为ADH。注意力将该病变排得较高，但很少排在第一；只向模型展示该病变帮助甚微，而使用病变级标签按每个决策训练的分类器改善了所有四个非典型边界。将ADH区域插入良性切片后，恶性肿瘤概率的升高幅度大于非典型增生概率。在拥有病理学家标注的单亚型切片的医院中以及HISTAI中，良性切片被评分的分数更接近病变，分诊特异性从0.48–0.53降至0.00–0.07和0.22。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Coronary Artery Disease: From Detection to Precision Management.
zh_title: 冠状动脉疾病中的人工智能：从检测到精准管理
summary: 综述梳理AI在冠心病筛查、无创影像、导管室与全程管理中的应用进展。
key_points: 深度学习心电图与电子病历标志物用于早期筛查
AI冠脉CTA自动钙化评分与无创FFR推导
血管造影生理评估与腔内影像分割辅助实时决策
reason: 信息量较足的综述，综述上限档，无原始数据
abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Coronary artery disease (CAD) remains the leading cause of death worldwide, yet the landscape is rapidly evolving as artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to its detection, diagnosis, and management. This review surveys the expanding role of AI across the full spectrum of CAD care. In screening, deep-learning electrocardiography and electronic health record-based digital markers enable earlier identification of clinically significant disease. In noninvasive imaging, AI-driven coronary computed tomography angiography automates calcium scoring, derives fractional flow reserve without invasive wires, and quantifies high-risk plaque features that predict incident adverse events. Within the cardiac catheterization laboratory, angiography-derived physiologic assessment and AI-guided intravascular imaging segmentation support real-time procedural decision-making. Beyond diagnosis, machine-learning models integrating multimodality imaging data improve risk stratification over conventional clinical scores, while pharmacogenomic algorithms and wearable-based digital rehabilitation platforms enable patient-centric secondary prevention. Despite this progress, significant challenges persist, including limited evidence from randomized trials, algorithmic bias in underrepresented populations, regulatory uncertainty surrounding software-as-a-medical-device frameworks, and the risk of clinician de-skilling. AI has the potential to act as a collaborative tool that augments-rather than replaces-physician judgment. Future directions include foundation models, multiomics integration, agentic AI workflows, and equity-centered deployment strategies to ensure that AI-driven advances benefit all individuals with CAD.
zh_abstract: 【Methodist DeBakey 心血管杂志】冠状动脉疾病（CAD）仍是全球主要死因，但随着人工智能（AI）越来越多地应用于其检测、诊断和管理，这一格局正在迅速演变。本综述考察了 AI 在 CAD 全程照护中日益扩大的作用。在筛查方面，深度学习心电图和基于电子健康记录的数字标志物使临床显著疾病能够更早识别。在无创成像方面，AI 驱动的冠状动脉计算机断层扫描血管造影可自动完成钙化评分、无需侵入性导丝即可推导血流储备分数，并量化可预测新发不良事件的高危斑块特征。在心导管室中，血管造影衍生的生理学评估和 AI 引导的血管内成像分割支持实时操作决策。在诊断之外，整合多模态影像数据的机器学习模型较传统临床评分改善风险分层，而药物基因组学算法和基于可穿戴设备的数字康复平台使以患者为中心的二级预防成为可能。尽管取得这些进展，仍存在重大挑战，包括随机试验证据有限、代表性不足人群中的算法偏倚、软件即医疗器械框架的监管不确定性以及临床医生技能退化的风险。AI 有潜力作为一种协作工具，增强而非替代医生的判断。未来方向包括基础模型、多组学整合、智能体 AI 工作流程以及以公平为中心的部署策略，以确保 AI 驱动的进步惠及所有 CAD 个体。

title: Naegele's rule is not a 280-day count: generative AI conflates two distinct pregnancy-dating algorithms.
zh_title: Naegele法则并非280天计数：生成式AI混淆两法
summary: 对1812–2025年全部末次月经日期比较两种预产期算法，并测试5个生成式AI系统能否披露并正确标注所用方法。
key_points: 78,163个日期中仅44.3%两法给出相同预产期
5个生成式AI系统×4个提示×3轮会话，共60条回答
评估AI是否披露并准确标注其使用的算法
reason: 小规模提示测试、任务单一，仅揭示算法标签问题，属增量档
abstract: [Journal of perinatal medicine] Naegele's calendar rule and an exact 280-day count are commonly treated as equivalent methods for estimating the due date (EDD), although their calendar arithmetic differs. We quantified this difference and evaluated whether generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems disclosed and accurately labeled the method used. A deterministic script calculated EDDs for every last menstrual period (LMP) date from January 1, 1812, through December 31, 2025, using Naegele's calendar rule and a fixed 280-day count. Five generative AI systems answered four prespecified LMP prompts, representing agreement and differences of 1, 2, and 3 days. Each prompt was submitted in three separate conversations, yielding 60 responses. Among 78,163 LMP dates, the methods produced identical EDDs in 34,609 cases (44.3 %) and different EDDs in 43,554 (55.7 %). Naegele's calendar rule produced dates 1 day later in 27.0 %, 2 days later in 21.0 %, and 3 days later in 7.7 %. The methods never agreed among 14,828 intervals containing February 29. Of 60 AI responses, 57 (95.0 %) included the exact 280-day date and 48 (80.0 %) stated a calculation method. Only 18 of 45 responses to divergent dates distinguished the algorithms. Twelve of 48 method-stating responses contained a method-label mismatch. Naegele's calendar rule and fixed 280-day counting are distinct algorithms. Their small numerical differences are unlikely to be clinically important, but they provide a deterministic test of computational transparency. Generative AI systems should disclose the calculation used, distinguish non-equivalent methods, and label them accurately.
zh_abstract: [Journal of perinatal medicine] Naegele日历法则和精确280天计数通常被视为估算预产期（EDD）的等效方法，尽管二者的日历算术不同。我们量化了这一差异，并评估生成式人工智能（AI）系统是否披露并准确标注了所使用的方法。一个确定性脚本使用Naegele日历法则和固定280天计数，计算1812年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间每个末次月经（LMP）日期的EDD。五个生成式AI系统回答了四个预先设定的LMP提示，分别代表一致以及相差1、2、3天的情况。每个提示在三个独立对话中提交，共获得60个回答。在78,163个LMP日期中，两种方法在34,609例（44.3%）中产生相同EDD，在43,554例（55.7%）中产生不同EDD。Naegele日历法则产生的日期晚1天者占27.0%，晚2天者占21.0%，晚3天者占7.7%。在包含2月29日的14,828个时间区间中，两种方法从未一致。在60个AI回答中，57个（95.0%）包含精确280天日期，48个（80.0%）说明了计算方法。在针对分歧日期的45个回答中，仅18个区分了算法。48个说明方法的回答中有12个存在方法标签不匹配。Naegele日历法则和固定280天计数是不同的算法。它们之间的小数值差异不太可能具有临床重要性，但为计算透明度提供了确定性测试。生成式AI系统应披露所使用的计算、区分非等效方法并准确标注它们。

title: OmitEHR: Scalable Omission Detection in LLM-Generated Clinical Summaries
zh_title: OmitEHR：LLM 临床摘要漏项的可扩展检测
summary: 提出无参考的漏项检测器 OmitEHR，从历史医生摘要学习临床显著性，用于发现 LLM 生成摘要遗漏的关键信息。
key_points: 以历史医生撰写的摘要作为显著性学习信号
在约 5000 例住院记录的出院小结摘要上应用
无需在推理时调用昂贵的 LLM 评判器
reason: 针对 LLM 摘要主要失效模式的清晰新方法，样本量可观，但为预印本且仅单一机构数据
abstract: Health systems increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to draft summaries of patient medical records, yet evaluations now find omissions, the absence of clinically important information, to be the most common failure mode. Detecting omissions in an LLM-generated summary requires knowing which facts in the record are salient, a signal that existing methods hand-specify, ignore, or recompute at inference with costly LLM judges. We present OmitEHR, a reference-free omission detector that learns clinical salience from historical clinician-written summaries predating widespread LLM use. OmitEHR learns to predict which source-note sentences clinicians include in their summaries, then surfaces high-salience sentences not covered by an LLM-generated summary as candidate omissions. We apply OmitEHR to brief hospital course (BHC) summarization using 5,000 admissions from a large academic medical center. On held-out admissions, OmitEHR outperformed all evaluated baselines at predicting salient source sentences, including a prompted LLM judge. The full omission detection pipeline took 17.7 to 19.5 seconds and cost \$0.03 to \$0.13 per summary depending on the base model, 1.6 to 1.7 times faster and 5.6 to 6.7 times cheaper than scoring every source sentence with an LLM judge. In a blinded review of 25 admissions, two board-certified clinicians confirmed a mean of 5.6 clinically meaningful omissions per summary surfaced by OmitEHR, compared with 3.3 for a full LLM pipeline, counting candidates confirmed by at least one clinician. The efficiency and validity of OmitEHR make it a practical tool for health systems to flag omissions before a summary reaches the clinician.
zh_abstract: 卫生系统日益依赖大型语言模型（large language models, LLMs）来起草患者病历摘要，然而当前评估发现，遗漏——即临床重要信息的缺失——是最常见的失败模式。检测 LLM 生成摘要中的遗漏需要知道记录中哪些事实是显著的，而现有方法要么手工指定这一信号，要么忽略它，要么在推理时使用昂贵的 LLM 评判器重新计算。我们提出 OmitEHR，一种无参考遗漏检测器，它从广泛使用 LLM 之前的、由临床医生撰写的历史摘要中学习临床显著性。OmitEHR 学习预测临床医生在其摘要中纳入哪些源记录句子，然后将 LLM 生成摘要未覆盖的高显著性句子作为候选遗漏呈现出来。我们将 OmitEHR 应用于简短住院病程（brief hospital course, BHC）摘要，使用来自一家大型学术医疗中心的 5,000 次入院记录。在留出的入院记录上，OmitEHR 在预测显著源句子方面优于所有评估的基线，包括提示式 LLM 评判器。完整遗漏检测流程耗时 17.7 至 19.5 秒，每次摘要成本为 0.03 至 0.13 美元，具体取决于基础模型，比使用 LLM 评判器对每个源句子评分快 1.6 至 1.7 倍、便宜 5.6 至 6.7 倍。在对 25 次入院的盲法审查中，两名委员会认证的临床医生确认，OmitEHR 每次摘要平均呈现 5.6 个有临床意义的遗漏，而完整 LLM 流程为 3.3 个（计数为至少一名临床医生确认的候选遗漏）。OmitEHR 的效率与有效性使其成为卫生系统在摘要到达临床医生之前标记遗漏的实用工具。

title: Agentic induction of common data elements and information extraction from sarcoma case report abstracts
zh_title: 智能体从肉瘤病例摘要自动归纳通用数据元素
summary: 用大模型智能体从24588篇PubMed摘要中归纳肉瘤通用数据元素，并做证据关联抽取，人工复核相关性83%。
key_points: 智能体初提72909个候选，整合后保留1570个
保留53个有至少50篇摘要支持的数据元素
100篇抽样中1116个非空抽取对与人工完全一致率94.9%
reason: 规模较大且有逐条人工复核，但为预印本、缺乏下游应用验证，属值得一看上限
abstract: Common data elements (CDEs) support clinical data comparability but are usually defined manually. We investigated whether large language model agents could derive a CDE schema from sarcoma case report abstracts and apply it at scale. An agent proposed 72,909 candidate CDEs from 24,588 PubMed abstracts; agentic consolidation yielded 1,570 CDEs. We retained 53 supported by at least 50 abstracts and attempted evidence-linked extraction across the corpus. Processing succeeded for all retained CDEs in 79.2% of abstracts, including responses indicating non-mention. Two human reviewers approved 83.0% of retained CDEs for relevance, 67.9% for clarity, and 56.6% for correctness. In 100 sampled abstracts, exact agreement with the value extracted by the LLM was 94.9% among 1,116 pairs with a non-empty answer (abstract-level bootstrap 95% CI, 93.0-96.4%). Errors concentrated in anatomical and temporal fields. These findings support agent-assisted schema drafting followed by expert curation before large-scale extraction.
zh_abstract: 通用数据元素（Common Data Elements, CDEs）支持临床数据的可比性，但通常由人工定义。我们研究了大型语言模型代理是否能从肉瘤病例报告摘要中推导出 CDE 模式，并在规模上应用它。一个代理从 24,588 篇 PubMed 摘要中提出 72,909 个候选 CDE；代理式整合产生 1,570 个 CDE。我们保留了至少由 50 篇摘要支持的 53 个 CDE，并尝试在整个语料库中进行证据关联提取。在 79.2% 的摘要中，所有保留的 CDE 均处理成功，包括表示未提及的响应。两名人类审阅者批准了 83.0% 的保留 CDE 的相关性、67.9% 的清晰性和 56.6% 的正确性。在 100 篇抽样摘要中，在 1,116 对具有非空答案的配对中，与 LLM 提取值的完全一致率为 94.9%（摘要级 bootstrap 95% CI，93.0–96.4%）。错误集中在解剖和时间字段。这些发现支持代理辅助的模式起草，随后在大规模提取前进行专家整理。

title: When Copying Is Hard to Beat: A Negative Result in Clinical Assessment Forecasting
zh_title: 临床评估预测中的阴性结果：复制基线难以超越
summary: 预印本在 29,715 个 ICU 日对上预测 45 项次日临床评估条目，发现所评估模型相对持久性基线无稳定优势。

abstract: We report a negative result in next-day clinical assessment forecasting: the evaluated models show no consistent advantage over strong persistence-based baselines. Clinicians can view the previous day's questionnaire answers, a plausible source of documentation persistence. Predicting 45 items on 29,715 ICU day-pairs with patient-disjoint splits, a physiology-informed gated model improves item-macro-F1 over a one-line clinical rule by +0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031], while losing accuracy. No macro-F1 advantage is established when the physiology window ends at the previous form's reference time (+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]), or when scoring excludes the 68.5% of cells derived from parent answers; combining both changes yields a small disadvantage. Four checkpoints across three families underperform persistence, and a fine-tuned one differs from it on only two cells. A categorical read-out raises changed-cell accuracy eightfold, but a state-only read-out scores higher overall than forecast-only decoding and matches a transition matrix. This negative result highlights how the documentation process, input cutoff, observation mask and decoding rule shape conclusions about forecasting recorded assessments.
zh_abstract: 我们报告次日临床评估预测中的一项阴性结果：所评估模型相较于强持续性基线未显示出一致优势。临床医生可以查看前一天的问卷答案，这是文档记录持续性的一个合理来源。在采用患者不相交划分的29,715个ICU日对上预测45个项目时，一个生理学信息引导的门控模型相较一条单行临床规则将项目级宏平均F1（item-macro-F1）提高了+0.0019 [+0.0006,+0.0031]，但准确率下降。当生理学窗口截止于前一份表单的参考时间时（+0.0001 [-0.0006,+0.0008]），或当评分排除由父答案衍生的68.5%单元格时，未确立宏平均F1（macro-F1）优势；将两项更改结合会产生小幅劣势。三个模型家族中的四个检查点表现不如持续性方法，而一个微调检查点仅在两个单元格上与其不同。分类读出将变化单元格准确率提高八倍，但仅状态读出在总体上得分高于仅预测解码，并与转移矩阵相匹配。这一阴性结果凸显了文档记录过程、输入截断、观察掩码和解码规则如何塑造关于预测已记录评估的结论。

People with AF may also have other heart problems, including reduced heart pumping function or diseases affecting the heart muscle or heart valves. Identifying these problems early is important because the condition of the heart can affect treatment decisions and long-term care. An ultrasound examination of the heart, called transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) or an echocardiogram, is commonly used to check how well the heart pumps blood and to look for structural problems, such as heart valve disease. However, an echocardiogram requires special equipment and trained healthcare professionals to perform and interpret the examination. Because of these requirements, it may not always be available when needed. This can be particularly challenging in situations where heart function needs to be evaluated quickly, such as when a patient with AF has a very fast heart rate. Delays may also occur in outpatient settings because of limited availability of echocardiography. Artificial intelligence (AI) technology may provide an additional way to identify patients who are more likely to have heart problems and who may benefit from further evaluation. A standard 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a simple and widely available test that records the electrical activity of the heart. AI-based computer programs can analyze information contained in an ECG that may not be easily recognized through routine interpretation. This study will use two AI-based ECG programs, called AiTiALVSD and AiTiALVDD. AiTiALVSD analyzes a standard 12-lead ECG to identify patients who may have reduced heart pumping function. Previous studies have evaluated this program in different clinical settings, including patients with AF and a fast heart rate. AiTiALVDD analyzes the ECG for signs that may be associated with difficulty in the heart relaxing and filling with blood. Problems with heart relaxation and filling may occur in several types of heart disease, including heart valve disease, abnormal thickening of the heart muscle, heart disease related to high blood pressure, diseases affecting the heart muscle, and coronary artery disease. abstract: [Journal of computer assisted tomography] Multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) improves detection of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) but is limited by inter-reader variability. Artificial intelligence (AI) has been increasingly applied to prostate segmentation and lesion detection, with heterogeneous results. Concerns remain regarding generalizability, data set bias, and validation. This review summarizes recent evidence on AI-assisted prostate MRI interpretation, identifies knowledge gaps, and outlines directions for future research. A systematic literature search of PubMed and Google Scholar was performed for studies published between January 2023 and April 2025 evaluating AI-assisted interpretation of biparametric or multiparametric prostate MRI. Reference lists were manually reviewed. Eligible studies assessed diagnostic performance of AI alone or in combination with radiologists. Eighteen studies met inclusion criteria from 157 screened. Standalone AI systems achieved areas under the curve (AUCs) ranging from 0.77 to 0.91, with sensitivities of 65.4% to 96% and specificities of 77.6% to 91%, occasionally outperforming radiologists. Hybrid AI-radiologist models improved inter-reader agreement, reduced interpretation time by up to 50%, and enhanced detection accuracy for equivocal (PI-RADS 3) lesions. AI assistance particularly benefited junior and general radiologists, improving diagnostic performance, confidence, and reproducibility. In active surveillance cohorts, AI demonstrated greater accuracy than radiologists for detecting disease progression (AUC=0.86 vs. 0.69), although specificity limitations persisted. Overall, AI integration into prostate MRI workflows demonstrates substantial potential to improve detection efficiency and standardization. Broader clinical adoption will require large-scale, multicenter validation, harmonized imaging protocols, and rigorous outcome-based evaluation.
zh_abstract: [Journal of computer assisted tomography] 多参数MRI（mpMRI）提高了临床显著前列腺癌（csPCa）的检测，但受阅片者间变异限制。人工智能（AI）越来越多地应用于前列腺分割和病灶检测，结果异质。关于泛化性、数据集偏倚和验证的担忧仍然存在。本综述总结了AI辅助前列腺MRI解读的最新证据，识别知识空白，并概述未来研究方向。我们对PubMed和Google Scholar进行了系统文献检索，纳入2023年1月至2025年4月发表的、评估AI辅助双参数或多参数前列腺MRI解读的研究。参考文献列表经人工审查。符合条件的研究评估了AI单独或与放射科医生联合的诊断性能。在筛选的157项研究中，18项符合纳入标准。独立AI系统达到的曲线下面积（AUC）范围为0.77至0.91，敏感性为65.4%至96%，特异性为77.6%至91%，有时优于放射科医生。AI-放射科医生混合模型改善了阅片者间一致性，将解读时间最多缩短50%，并提高了对不确定（PI-RADS 3）病灶的检测准确性。AI辅助尤其使初级和普通放射科医生受益，提高了诊断性能、信心和可重复性。在主动监测队列中，AI在检测疾病进展方面表现出比放射科医生更高的准确性（AUC=0.86 vs. 0.69），尽管特异性局限仍然存在。总体而言，将AI整合到前列腺MRI工作流程中显示出提高检测效率和标准化的巨大潜力。更广泛的临床采用将需要大规模、多中心验证、统一的成像方案以及严格的基于结局的评估。

title: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Pulmonary Hypertension Using Early-Fused CTPA and Pulmonary Artery Segmentation Maps.
zh_title: 融合CTPA与肺动脉分割图的肺高压深度学习分类
summary: 纳入317例患者，将CTPA图像与肺动脉分割图融合，用四种深度模型区分肺高压及CTEPH亚型。
