abstract: [Pulmonary circulation] Computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is vital for diagnosing pulmonary hypertension (PH), especially thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH). However, manual image interpretation of CTPA often leads to misdiagnosis. This study aims to automatically segment the pulmonary artery from CTPA images and develop a deep learning model by fusing CTPA images with pulmonary artery segmentation results to distinguish pulmonary hypertension (PH vs. subjects without PH (no-PH)) and its PH subtype, CTEPH (CTEPH, other PH vs. no-PH). The study included 92 patients with CTEPH, 85 patients with other types of PH, and 140 no-PH. We completed the image preprocessing and segmentation of the pulmonary arterial tree of all the sample data. Based on four deep learning model classifiers-ResNet50, DenseNet, SENet, and Swin Transformer, we respectively developed four distinct network architectures: Single input channel for CTPA images, as well as early, middle, and late fusion strategies that combine CTPA images with their corresponding pulmonary vascular segmentation maps. The performance of the testing experiments has shown that the DenseNet (CTPA-seg) early fusion model achieves optimal performance in the binary classification task of pulmonary hypertension (PH vs. no-PH), with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.927. Meanwhile, the Swin Transformer (CTPA-seg) early fusion model shows the best performance in the ternary classification of pulmonary hypertension subtypes (CTEPH, other PH vs. no-PH), achieving an AUC of 0.855. Compared with models that only use clinical images, the early feature fusion strategy shows significantly higher accuracy in classifying and diagnosing PH, which is beneficial for the differential diagnosis of CTEPH.
zh_abstract: [Pulmonary circulation] 计算机断层扫描肺动脉造影（CTPA）对于诊断肺动脉高压（PH），尤其是血栓栓塞性肺动脉高压（CTEPH）至关重要。然而，CTPA 的人工图像解读常导致误诊。本研究旨在从 CTPA 图像中自动分割肺动脉，并通过融合 CTPA 图像与肺动脉分割结果来开发深度学习模型，以区分肺动脉高压（PH 与无 PH 受试者（no-PH））及其 PH 亚型 CTEPH（CTEPH、其他 PH 与 no-PH）。研究纳入 92 例 CTEPH 患者、85 例其他类型 PH 患者和 140 例 no-PH。我们完成了所有样本数据的图像预处理和肺动脉树分割。基于四种深度学习模型分类器——ResNet50、DenseNet、SENet 和 Swin Transformer，我们分别开发了四种不同的网络架构：CTPA 图像单输入通道，以及将 CTPA 图像与其对应肺血管分割图相结合的早期、中期和晚期融合策略。测试实验性能显示，DenseNet（CTPA-seg）早期融合模型在肺动脉高压二分类任务（PH 对 no-PH）中取得最佳性能，曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.927。同时，Swin Transformer（CTPA-seg）早期融合模型在肺动脉高压亚型三分类（CTEPH、其他 PH 对 no-PH）中表现最佳，AUC 为 0.855。与仅使用临床图像的模型相比，早期特征融合策略在 PH 分类和诊断中显示出显著更高的准确性，这有利于 CTEPH 的鉴别诊断。

title: High Time for Pathology AI: Practical Considerations for Turning Potential into Practice.
zh_title: 病理AI落地的实践考量

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to improve diagnostic accuracy, reproducibility, and efficiency in anatomical pathology, but technical success alone does not establish clinical utility. In this Perspective, we examine practical requirements for translating computational pathology tools into routine practice, including prioritization of genuine clinical bottlenecks, representative datasets, independent validation, workflow integration, costs, clinician oversight, regulatory compliance, and post-deployment monitoring. We distinguish evidence from retrospective model evaluations, controlled reader studies, prospective workflow assessments, and economic simulations, recognizing that their conclusions are not interchangeable. We also propose a staged, decision-oriented framework through which laboratories can assess clinical need, select technologies, perform local validation, conduct prospective pilots, deploy with safeguards, and monitor performance throughout the AI lifecycle. Evidence from selected applications is encouraging, but effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, and readiness for routine use vary by intended purpose and practice environment. Responsible adoption should therefore be guided by demonstrated clinical benefit, operational feasibility, and ongoing evaluation rather than algorithmic performance alone.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics（Basel，Switzerland）] 人工智能（AI）有潜力提高解剖病理学的诊断准确性、可重复性和效率，但仅技术成功并不能确立临床实用性。在本展望（Perspective）中，我们审视将计算病理学工具转化到常规实践中的实际要求，包括优先处理真正的临床瓶颈、代表性数据集、独立验证、工作流程整合、成本、临床医生监督、法规合规以及部署后监测。我们区分来自回顾性模型评估、受控阅片者研究、前瞻性工作流程评估和经济模拟的证据，并认识到这些研究的结论不可互换。我们还提出一个分阶段、以决策为导向的框架，实验室可通过该框架评估临床需求、选择技术、进行本地验证、开展前瞻性试点、在保障措施下部署，并在整个人工智能生命周期中监测性能。来自选定应用的证据令人鼓舞，但有效性、成本效益和常规使用的准备程度因预期用途和实践环境而异。因此，负责任的采用应以已证实的临床获益、操作可行性和持续评估为指导，而不仅仅是算法性能。

abstract: [Psychiatry research. Neuroimaging] Alzheimer's disease is the most prevalent neurodegenerative disease, resulting in progressive memory loss in people. It has a significant impact on the population and the global healthcare system. Disease acquisition is a major concern due to the absence of pre-existing treatment options. The growth of machine learning and deep learning-based algorithms is effective in analyzing EEG data for diagnosing Alzheimer's disease. This systematic literature review investigates existing primary studies that focus on applying ML and DL in the identification of Alzheimer's disease, with emphasis on pre-processing, feature extraction, and classification. In doing so, it assesses the results produced by varying algorithms and addresses the problems encountered while deploying these systems. The review's objective is to offer a current situation and potential solutions for practitioners and scholars interested in healthcare service issues.
zh_abstract: [Psychiatry research. Neuroimaging] 阿尔茨海默病是最常见的神经退行性疾病，导致人们进行性记忆丧失。它对人群和全球医疗保健系统有重大影响。由于缺乏现有治疗方案，疾病的发生成为主要关切。机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）算法的增长可有效分析 EEG 数据以诊断阿尔茨海默病。本系统文献综述调查现有原始研究，这些研究聚焦于应用 ML 和 DL 识别阿尔茨海默病，重点在于预处理、特征提取和分类。在此过程中，它评估不同算法产生的结果，并处理部署这些系统时遇到的问题。该综述的目标是为对医疗服务问题感兴趣的从业者和学者提供当前状况和潜在解决方案。

title: Machine learning-enhanced analysis of vascular regression in diabetic retinopathy.
zh_title: 机器学习量化糖尿病视网膜病变血管退化
summary: 在链脲佐菌素糖尿病小鼠模型中，用机器学习识别胶原IV阳性、CD31阴性的基底膜袖套以量化毛细血管退化。
key_points: 以胶原IV阳性/CD31阴性界定退化毛细血管
观察视网膜三层血管均出现退化
深层血管丛退化袖套更多
reason: 临床前动物模型、单中心小规模，属增量档
abstract: [Experimental eye research] Diabetic retinopathy is an ischemic retinal disease characterized by early capillary regression (i.e., vascular rarefaction) followed by pathological angiogenesis. Accurate quantification of vascular regression is essential for understanding disease mechanisms and evaluating therapeutic strategies, yet current methods often rely on manual counting of regression markers and remain limited in throughput and reproducibility. In this study, we identified regressed capillaries by constricted basement membrane sleeves that persist after endothelial cell loss. These sleeves immunostain positively for Collagen IV but are negative for the endothelial marker CD31. Using a streptozotocin-induced diabetic mouse model, we observed capillary regression across all three layers of the retinal vasculature, with more regression sleeves in the deep vascular plexus compared to the superficial and intermediate layers. To quantify capillary regression, we developed complementary workflows for detecting regression sleeves, including manual annotation in Adobe Photoshop, two semi-automated approaches using ImageJ and Python, and a fully automated deep-learning approach based on a UNet convolutional neural network. The deep learning model was trained using manually annotated images and generated prediction masks that closely matched manual annotations in independent test images. Across diabetic retinas, the UNet-based approach produced sleeve counts comparable to manual quantification. In addition to sleeve count, the UNet approach enabled quantitative assessment of sleeve length, revealing a trend toward increased average sleeve length in diabetic retinas compared with non-diabetic controls. Together, these findings establish a flexible, scalable, and reproducible toolkit for quantifying retinal vascular regression. This work may facilitate mechanistic studies of vascular remodeling and improve quantitative assessment of pathological vascular regression in early stages of diabetic retinopathy.
zh_abstract: [Experimental eye research] 糖尿病视网膜病变是一种缺血性视网膜疾病，其特征是早期毛细血管退化（即血管稀疏）随后出现病理性血管生成。准确量化血管退化对于理解疾病机制和评估治疗策略至关重要，然而当前方法往往依赖人工计数退化标志物，并且在通量和可重复性方面仍有限。在本研究中，我们通过内皮细胞丢失后持续存在的收缩基底膜袖套来识别退化毛细血管。这些袖套对 IV 型胶原（Collagen IV）免疫染色阳性，但对内皮标志物 CD31 呈阴性。使用链脲佐菌素（streptozotocin）诱导的糖尿病小鼠模型，我们观察到视网膜血管系统全部三层均发生毛细血管退化，与浅层和中间层相比，深层血管丛中的退化袖套更多。为了量化毛细血管退化，我们开发了用于检测退化袖套的互补工作流程，包括在 Adobe Photoshop 中人工标注、使用 ImageJ 和 Python 的两种半自动方法，以及基于 UNet 卷积神经网络的完全自动化深度学习方法。该深度学习模型使用人工标注图像进行训练，并在独立测试图像中生成与人工标注密切匹配的预测掩膜。在糖尿病视网膜中，基于 UNet 的方法产生的袖套计数与人工量化相当。除袖套计数外，UNet 方法还能够定量评估袖套长度，揭示出与未糖尿病对照相比，糖尿病视网膜中平均袖套长度有增加趋势。总之，这些发现建立了一个灵活、可扩展且可重复的工具包，用于量化视网膜血管退化。这项工作可能促进血管重塑的机制研究，并改善糖尿病视网膜病变早期病理性血管退化的定量评估。

title: ProtFlap: Structure-based Deep Learning Prediction of Protein Flexibility from Atomic Energy Networks
zh_title: ProtFlap：从静态结构预测蛋白柔性
summary: 预印本提出图神经网络ProtFlap，从静态蛋白结构预测残基级相对柔性，无需分子动力学采样。
key_points: 以残基相互作用图表征蛋白
融合经验能量网络信息
面向可扩展的柔性预测
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，证据与外部验证信息有限
abstract: Protein flexibility is a key determinant of molecular recognition, catalysis, and regulation, yet remains difficult to characterise at scale. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations provide detailed descriptions of time-dependent dynamics but are computationally expensive. Although recent AI-based structure prediction methods have substantially improved access to high-quality static protein structures, they inherently lack information regarding the dynamic fluctuations essential for functional understanding. There is therefore a need for scalable, structure-based computational approaches that can infer intrinsic protein flexibility without explicit dynamical sampling. We present ProtFlap, a graph neural network framework for predicting relative residue-level flexibility directly from static protein structures. ProtFlap represents proteins as residue interaction graphs and integrates empirical atomic energy features extracted from a single energy-minimised snapshot with structural and sequence-derived descriptors. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that the local atomic energy network encoded in a frozen protein structure contains sufficient information to estimate structural flexibility. Trained using atomic mobility labels, quantified via normalised root-mean-square fluctuation (RMSF) derived from short MD simulations, ProtFlap achieves robust and accurate flexibility prediction across diverse protein domains. Feature attribution analysis reveals that van der Waals-related energy terms are the dominant contributors to the prediction.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质柔性是分子识别、催化和调节的关键决定因素，但大规模表征仍然困难。分子动力学（MD）模拟可提供随时间变化的动力学的详细描述，但计算成本高昂。尽管近期基于 AI 的结构预测方法大幅改善了对高质量静态蛋白质结构的获取，但它们本质上缺乏对于功能理解至关重要的动态波动信息。因此，需要可扩展的、基于结构的计算方法，能够在不进行显式动力学采样的情况下推断蛋白质内在柔性。我们提出 ProtFlap，一个图神经网络框架，用于直接从静态蛋白质结构预测相对残基水平的柔性。ProtFlap 将蛋白质表示为残基相互作用图，并将从单一能量最小化快照中提取的经验原子能量特征与结构和序列衍生描述符相结合。我们方法的核心是这样一个假设：冻结蛋白质结构中编码的局部原子能量网络包含足够信息来估计结构柔性。ProtFlap 使用原子迁移率标签进行训练，这些标签通过源自短程 MD 模拟的归一化均方根涨落（RMSF）量化，并在多种蛋白质结构域上实现了稳健且准确的柔性预测。特征归因分析显示，范德华相关能量项是预测的主要贡献因素。

title: Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection
zh_title: 人机协同证据校准扩展大模型治疗线数判定
summary: 预印本提出证据校准选择框架，以大模型加人工复核方式扩展肿瘤治疗线数判定。
key_points: 治疗线数判定是肿瘤队列构建的主要瓶颈
大模型判读可靠性随病例复杂度波动
框架提供可信度依据并标记需人工复核病例
reason: 方法有新意且针对真实临床流程，但属未经同行评审、无外部验证的预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. As the evidence base grows, ECS continuously calibrates confidence to estimate residual error, thus enabling more efficient use of clinician time. In simulations on 136 clinician adjudicated patients with multiple myeloma, ECS achieved a residual error of 5% after review of 44.6% of patients, compared to 62.2% when review was directed by LLM self-reported confidence and 81.9% under random sampling. These results support a scalable approach to study-specific LoT adjudication, using clinician evidence to inform automated predictions, minimize error, and reduce review burden.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）使原本依赖详尽人工审查的临床裁定任务能够规模化实施。治疗线数（LoT）裁定是肿瘤队列构建中的主要瓶颈，就是一个典型例子。必须根据细致且特定于研究的定义，从纵向治疗史中推断治疗线边界，并且对每位患者的每次方案转换都要如此。LLMs可以大规模执行这种裁定，但其可靠性因患者而异。治疗史的复杂程度各不相同，模糊或不典型模式依赖专家临床判断。因此，可靠的自动化需要对模型分配提供经过验证的支持，并具备识别需要人工审查病例的能力。在此，我们提出证据校准选择（ECS），这是一个用于规模化LLM辅助LoT裁定的人在回路框架。ECS从观察到的临床医生裁定中推导置信度，优先对分配支持最少的患者进行后续审查，并将已完成的裁定作为先例返回给模型。随着证据基础增长，ECS持续校准置信度以估计残余误差，从而更高效地利用临床医生时间。在136例经临床医生裁定的多发性骨髓瘤患者中进行的模拟中，ECS在审查44.6%的患者后实现了5%的残余误差，相比之下，由LLM自报置信度指导审查时为62.2%，随机抽样下为81.9%。这些结果支持一种可扩展的、针对特定研究的LoT裁定方法：利用临床医生证据为自动化预测提供依据、尽量减少误差并减轻审查负担。

title: Revealing the transcriptomic organization of extrasomatic interfaces using SCOUBI
zh_title: SCOUBI解析空间转录组中胞体外RNA的轴突-树突界面
summary: 预印本提出计算框架SCOUBI，用神经网络从空间转录组的胞体外RNA识别轴突-树突界面。
key_points: 指出空间转录组中大量转录本位于细胞体之外
依据标记基因划分轴突与树突富集区室
揭示神经组织中被忽略的分子功能层
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，但证据与外部验证有限
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) generates substantial transcript signal outside segmented cell bodies, which is generally discarded by analysis tools. This is especially problematic for brain ST data, as neuronal mRNAs can be localized far from somata - in axons, dendrites, and synaptic compartments - and up to half of the transcripts in ST data may lie outside cell bodies. Here, we present SCOUBI, a computational framework that identifies axon-dendrite interfaces from extrasomatic RNA in ST data, revealing a hitherto overlooked layer of molecular function in neural tissues. It first partitions extrasomatic space into axon- and dendrite-enriched compartments based on known marker genes, using a neural network trained to maximize marker specificity and inter-compartment communication signals. It then defines interfaces as loci where predicted axonal and dendritic compartments converge and exhibit ligand-receptor colocalization. Applied to mouse brain, SCOUBI creates maps of axonal and dendritic compartments and their interfaces that align with known spatial patterns of neurite and synaptic distribution. It identifies transcriptomic differences between interfaces and the surrounding extrasomatic space, revealing region-specific signatures of neuronal signaling and synaptic plasticity. By comparing interface transcript enrichment with local somatic expression, SCOUBI identifies genes that preferentially localize at sites of intercellular communication rather than simply reflecting nearby cell bodies. SCOUBI reveals interface-associated transcripts beyond established synaptic genes, with molecular signatures reproducible across independent samples and imaging platforms. In summary, SCOUBI transforms a substantial and often-discarded aspect of ST data into an interpretable readout of subcellular organization and neural signaling.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）在分割的细胞体之外产生大量转录本信号，这些信号通常被分析工具丢弃。这对脑ST数据尤其成问题，因为神经元mRNA可定位在远离胞体的位置——在轴突、树突和突触区室中——并且ST数据中多达一半的转录本可能位于细胞体之外。在此，我们提出SCOUBI，一种从ST数据中的胞体外RNA识别轴突-树突界面的计算框架，揭示了神经组织中迄今被忽视的一层分子功能。它首先基于已知标记基因将胞体外空间划分为轴突富集和树突富集的区室，使用经过训练以最大化标记特异性和区室间通讯信号的神经网络。然后，它将界面定义为预测的轴突和树突区室汇聚并表现出配体-受体共定位的位点。应用于小鼠脑时，SCOUBI创建了轴突和树突区室及其界面的图谱，这些图谱与已知的神经突和突触分布空间模式一致。它识别界面与周围胞体外空间之间的转录组差异，揭示神经元信号传导和突触可塑性的区域特异性特征。通过比较界面转录本富集与局部胞体表达，SCOUBI识别出优先定位在细胞间通讯位点而非仅仅反映邻近细胞体的基因。SCOUBI揭示了已确立的突触基因之外的界面相关转录本，其分子特征可在独立样本和成像平台之间重现。总之，SCOUBI将ST数据中一个量大且常被丢弃的方面转化为对亚细胞组织和神经信号传导的可解释读出。
