reason: 预印本方法改进，条目未说明基线对比与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Single-cell transcriptome sequencing has been widely applied across the life sciences. It enables accurate and robust identification of cell types in heterogeneous biological tissues through unsupervised clustering, shallow learning, and deep learning. While deep learning does not outperform shallow learning in classification performance, it streamlines cell type identification by eliminating cumbersome preprocessing procedures. However, the availability of training datasets with comprehensive cell type annotations is always limited, so new datasets inevitably contain cell populations that are not pre-defined in the training data. To address this limitation, we integrated unsupervised clustering with transformer-based models to identify cell populations unrecognized by classical methods. Specifically, we developed the Nankai GeneRank Classifier by fine-tuning the pre-trained Geneformer-V1 model, and then clustered cells based on its softmax-normalized class probability matrix (SCPM). Applied to a public colorectal cancer dataset, the new method, named SCPM-based clustering, resolved cell populations that cannot be unambiguously identified by classical methods alone and led to the discovery of novel candidate markers of colorectal cancer stem cells, demonstrating its utility.
zh_abstract: 单细胞转录组测序已在生命科学领域广泛应用。它通过无监督聚类、浅层学习和深度学习，能够在异质性生物组织中准确且稳健地识别细胞类型。尽管深度学习在分类性能上并不优于浅层学习，但它通过省去繁琐的预处理流程，简化了细胞类型识别。然而，具有全面细胞类型注释的训练数据集总是有限的，因此新数据集不可避免地包含训练数据中未预先定义的细胞群体。为解决这一局限，我们将无监督聚类与基于Transformer的模型整合，以识别经典方法未识别出的细胞群体。具体而言，我们通过微调预训练的Geneformer-V1模型开发了Nankai GeneRank分类器，然后基于其softmax归一化类别概率矩阵（SCPM）对细胞进行聚类。将该新方法（命名为基于SCPM的聚类）应用于一个公开的结直肠癌数据集时，它解析了仅靠经典方法无法明确识别的细胞群体，并促成了结直肠癌干细胞新型候选标志物的发现，展示了其效用。

title: Estimating Outpatient Visit Prices from Hospital Price Transparency Data using Large Language Models
zh_title: 用大模型从医院价格透明数据估算门诊就诊价格
summary: 预印本提出基于RAG的大模型框架，从三家医院价格透明文件中估算单项与成组诊疗价格。
key_points: 比较BM25、嵌入模型与GPT-BM25混合检索
GPT-BM25最优，单项价格MAPE 19.44%
成组价格MAPE 4.90%，并用合成模拟评估按症状就诊费用
reason: 预印本、仅三家医院数据、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Objective: Hospital care prices in the United States have increased substantially, yet patients lack effective tools to access and compare costs. We aimed to develop and evaluate an LLM-based approach for improving access to and use of hospital price transparency (PT) data. Materials and Methods: To estimate visit prices, we used a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework to analyze PT files from three major hospitals in Maryland and the surrounding region. We compared BM25, OpenAI embedding models, and a GPT-BM25 hybrid against a no-RAG baseline for cost estimation of individual procedures and procedure groups, then evaluated the best approach for symptom-based visit cost estimation using synthetic simulations. Results: Across hospitals, the GPT-BM25 retriever achieved the best performance, with average price MAPE of 19.44% for individual procedures and 4.90% for groups, compared with 147.98% and 82.82%, respectively, for the no-RAG baseline. In simulations, our framework correctly identified approximately 50% of reference procedures and reduced MAPE relative to the LLM-only baseline at two of the three hospitals, while achieving comparable performance at the third. Discussion: Our framework uses RAG to improve care price estimation in real-world settings. Compared with the no-RAG baseline, it substantially improved cost estimates for both individual procedures and procedure groups. Improvements were smaller in synthetic simulations, likely because inferring procedures from clinical information is more complex. Practical challenges remain, including heterogeneous PT file formats, unexplained duplicate entries, and limited availability of insurer-negotiated rates. Conclusion: LLMs that effectively integrate PT data show strong potential to provide patients with more accessible and accurate healthcare cost estimates.
zh_abstract: 【目的】美国医院诊疗价格已大幅上涨，但患者缺乏有效工具来获取和比较费用。我们旨在开发并评估一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法，以改善对医院价格透明度（PT）数据的获取和使用。【材料与方法】为估算就诊价格，我们使用检索增强生成（RAG）框架分析马里兰州及周边地区三家大型医院的PT文件。我们比较了BM25、OpenAI嵌入模型和GPT-BM25混合方法，与无RAG基线在单项操作和操作组费用估算上的表现，然后使用合成模拟评估最佳方法用于基于症状的就诊费用估算。【结果】在各医院中，GPT-BM25检索器取得最佳性能，单项操作的平均价格MAPE为19.44%，操作组为4.90%，而无RAG基线分别为147.98%和82.82%。在模拟中，我们的框架正确识别了约50%的参考操作，并在三家医院中的两家相对于仅LLM基线降低了MAPE，而在第三家表现相当。【讨论】我们的框架使用RAG改善真实世界环境中的诊疗价格估算。与无RAG基线相比，它大幅改善了单项操作和操作组的费用估算。在合成模拟中改善较小，可能是因为从临床信息推断操作更为复杂。实际挑战仍然存在，包括PT文件格式异质、无法解释的重复条目以及保险协商费率可用性有限。【结论】有效整合PT数据的LLM显示出为患者提供更可及、更准确的医疗费用估算的强大潜力。

title: Automated Left Ventricle Strain Analysis from DENSE MRI
zh_title: DENSE MRI左心室应变的自动化分析
summary: 提出全自动框架，整合多通道nnU-Net分割、自动相位解缠、正则化时空最小二乘位移与应变计算，实现全左心室应变估计。
key_points: 多通道nnU-Net联合幅度与相位图像分割
自动相位解缠与正则化时空最小二乘位移
径向基插值计算全层短轴应变
reason: 全自动流程预印本，摘要未显示外部验证或大样本，属增量档
abstract: Background: Quantifying myocardial strains from Displacement ENcoding with Stimulated Echoes (DENSE) MRI provides insight into left ventricular performance, but current data processing pipelines remain limited in automation, robustness, and full left ventricle coverage. Methods: We present a fully automated framework for voxel-wise displacement and strain analysis of the left ventricle from DENSE MRI. Our method integrates a multi-channel nnU-Net model trained on both magnitude and phase images for segmentation, an automated phase unwrapping approach, an adaptation of the regularized spatiotemporal least squares (RSTLS) formulation for displacement computation, and strain calculations based on radial basis function interpolation. The proposed framework enables the estimation of displacements and strains across the left ventricle from a full stack of short-axis images. Results: Validation using a computational phantom shows the framework's overall resilience to data noise. Following computational phantom evaluation, the proposed framework is applied to analyze DENSE MRI short-axis slices acquired in forty-seven (N=47) healthy volunteers and covering the full left ventricle. Circumferential, longitudinal, and radial strains are presented throughout the cardiac cycle and at peak systole, showcasing the performance of the proposed framework. Results show that circumferential and longitudinal strains are computed accurately. However, challenges persist when estimating radial strain, especially in the subendocardial layer. A group-wise strain comparison is also performed based on volunteers' sex and age showing a significant effect of sex on circumferential and longitudinal strains. Conclusions: Overall, the proposed framework provides an automated and modular pipeline to compute displacements and strains from DENSE MR images that can be scaled and generalized toward clinical applications.
zh_abstract: 【背景】从刺激回波位移编码（Displacement ENcoding with Stimulated Echoes, DENSE）MRI定量心肌应变可深入了解左心室功能，但当前的数据处理流程在自动化、稳健性和全左心室覆盖方面仍然有限。【方法】我们提出一个全自动框架，用于从DENSE MRI进行左心室体素级位移和应变分析。我们的方法整合了一个在幅度图和相位图上训练的多通道nnU-Net分割模型、一种自动相位解缠方法、针对位移计算改编的正则化时空最小二乘（regularized spatiotemporal least squares, RSTLS）公式，以及基于径向基函数插值的应变计算。所提出的框架能够从完整短轴图像层栈估计整个左心室的位移和应变。【结果】使用计算体模进行验证显示，该框架总体上对数据噪声具有稳健性。在计算体模评估之后，所提出的框架被应用于分析47名（N=47）健康志愿者采集的、覆盖完整左心室的DENSE MRI短轴切片。呈现了整个心动周期和收缩峰值时的周向、纵向和径向应变，展示了所提出框架的性能。结果表明，周向和纵向应变计算准确。然而，在估计径向应变时仍存在挑战，尤其是在心内膜下层。还根据志愿者的性别和年龄进行了组间应变比较，显示性别对周向和纵向应变有显著影响。【结论】总体而言，所提出的框架提供了一种自动化、模块化的流程，可从DENSE MR图像计算位移和应变，并可扩展和推广至临床应用。

title: Assessing the Use, Impact, and Perspectives of Generative Artificial Intelligence Among Health Consumers: A Cross-Sectional Survey in Saudi Arabia.
zh_title: 沙特健康消费者使用生成式AI的横断面调查
summary: 沙特阿拉伯成人线上横断面调查，考察健康消费者使用生成式AI获取健康信息的频率、影响与看法。
key_points: 对象为≥18岁、过去一年用生成式AI查健康信息的成人
线上自填问卷，2026年两轮收集
探索性横断面设计，采用双变量分析
reason: 单国横断面自报调查，无临床结局，属增量档。
abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] Saudi Health consumers increasingly rely on generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) to access health information from a growing number of health-related resources. Little is known about the frequency and patterns of generative AI tool use for seeking health information among consumers, its reported impact, and health consumers' perceptions of these tools. This study aims to investigate the use of and perspectives on generative AI tools among health consumers in Saudi Arabia (SA). It also aims to assess the impact of their use on health-seeking behaviours. An exploratory, cross-sectional, self-administered online survey was distributed to adults (≥18 years) residing in SA during two data collection rounds in 2026 (March-April and July-August). All adults who used generative AI tools to seek online health information in the past year were included. Bivariate and multivariate analyses were conducted to examine relationships among variables. A total of 403 eligible health consumers (58% male) participated. Among respondents who had used generative AI for health purposes, approximately 49% reported using it more than five times per month. Younger age, higher income, and more frequent pre-use were associated with higher odds of frequent seeking health information behaviour. Headache, abdominal pain, and musculoskeletal pain were the most common claims. ChatGPT was the main platform (84%) used for seeking information. Age was significantly negatively associated with frequency, whereas income and pre-visit use were positively associated. The primary reasons for seeking health information via generative AI were quick information retrieval (71%), time saving (34%), and curiosity (30.5%). The high frequency of use suggests that generative AI can serve as a source of health information and may lead users to withhold health information from healthcare providers. It may influence subsequent health-seeking behaviours, such as requesting urgent care or postponing physician visits. These self-reported findings do not establish diagnostic accuracy, clinical effectiveness, or patient safety, and the clinical risk and appropriateness of self-management actions were not assessed. Many respondents reported concerns about inaccurate information, missed serious illness, and increased health anxiety.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] 沙特健康消费者越来越依赖生成式人工智能（AI）从日益增多的健康相关资源中获取健康信息。关于消费者使用生成式 AI 工具寻求健康信息的频率和模式、其报告的影响以及健康消费者对这些工具的看法，人们知之甚少。本研究旨在调查沙特阿拉伯（SA）健康消费者对生成式 AI 工具的使用情况和观点。它还旨在评估其使用对健康寻求行为的影响。研究在 2026 年的两轮数据收集期间（3 月至 4 月和 7 月至 8 月），向居住在 SA 的成年人（≥18 岁）发放了一项探索性、横断面、自填式在线调查。纳入过去一年使用生成式 AI 工具寻求在线健康信息的所有成年人。进行了双变量和多变量分析以检验变量之间的关系。共有 403 名符合条件的健康消费者（58% 为男性）参与。在曾将生成式 AI 用于健康目的的受访者中，约 49% 报告每月使用超过五次。较年轻年龄、较高收入和更频繁的使用前使用与更频繁寻求健康信息行为的更高几率相关。头痛、腹痛和肌肉骨骼疼痛是最常见的主诉。ChatGPT 是用于寻求信息的主要平台（84%）。年龄与频率显著负相关，而收入和就诊前使用呈正相关。通过生成式 AI 寻求健康信息的主要原因包括快速获取信息（71%）、节省时间（34%）和好奇心（30.5%）。高使用频率表明，生成式 AI 可作为健康信息来源，并可能导致用户向医疗保健提供者隐瞒健康信息。它可能影响后续健康寻求行为，例如请求紧急护理或推迟就医。这些自我报告发现不能确立诊断准确性、临床有效性或患者安全性，也未评估自我管理行为的临床风险和适当性。许多受访者报告了对不准确信息、漏诊严重疾病和健康焦虑增加的担忧。

title: Multimodal AI in Healthcare: Review of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Real-World Medical Applications
zh_title: 医疗多模态AI：视觉语言基础模型应用综述
summary: 预印本综述梳理医疗视觉语言基础模型在图像解读、报告生成与问答等真实场景的应用分类。
key_points: 强调图文对齐可减少人工标注依赖
覆盖图像解读、报告生成、问答任务
提出医疗多模态模型的分类体系
reason: 预印本综述，无原始数据与验证，属综述档上限内偏下
abstract: The emergence of foundation models has marked a transformative shift in AI, enabling robust generalization across diverse downstream tasks through putative zero-shot learning. Large Language Models and Vision Language Models have demonstrated strong capabilities in tasks such as image interpretation, report generation, and question answering by effectively learning from multimodal data-images paired with associated text often with minimal supervision. In the healthcare domain, this ability to align visual and textual information reduces the reliance on extensive manual annotations, as models can leverage existing clinical reports and imaging data to learn meaningful representations. This integration holds promise for improving diagnostic support, treatment planning, and overall patient care, even in data constrained settings. In this review, we provide a definitive taxonomy of the medical VLM landscape, tracing the evolution from early Contrastive Alignment and Generative MLLMs to the cutting edge frontiers of Dense Pixel Grounding, Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and Reasoning Incentivized (RL) architectures. We critically examine the "medical bottleneck" identifying the persistent challenges of data scarcity, the "hallucination" risks in generative diagnostics, the computational strain of 3D volumetric processing, and the lack of standardized, clinically grounded evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 基础模型的出现标志着AI的变革性转变，通过假定的零样本学习，使跨多样下游任务具有稳健泛化能力。大语言模型和视觉语言模型通过有效学习多模态数据——即与相关文本配对的图像——通常在极少监督下，已在图像解读、报告生成和问答等任务中展现出强大能力。在医疗领域，这种对齐视觉和文本信息的能力减少了对大量人工标注的依赖，因为模型可以利用现有临床报告和影像数据学习有意义的表征。这种整合有望改善诊断支持、治疗规划和整体患者护理，即使在数据受限环境中也是如此。在本综述中，我们提供医学VLM领域的权威分类体系，追溯从早期对比对齐（Contrastive Alignment）和生成式多模态大语言模型（Generative MLLMs）到密集像素定位（Dense Pixel Grounding）、稀疏专家混合（Sparse Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）和推理激励（Reasoning Incentivized, RL）架构等前沿的演进。我们批判性审视“医学瓶颈”，识别数据稀缺的持续挑战、生成式诊断中的“幻觉”风险、3D体积处理的计算压力以及缺乏标准化、具有临床依据的评估指标。

title: SEAT: Sign-Type Evidence-Audited Transport for Multi-Label Tongue Diagnosis
zh_title: SEAT：证据可审计的多标签舌象诊断
summary: 提出按证据类型分别匹配预测与评估机制的可审计框架，基于冻结DINOv2特征进行舌象多标签征象识别。
key_points: 单张舌象常并存多类异质证据的征象
掩膜引导的征象特异注意力定位局部形态
基于LAB/HSV色彩原型的半松弛最优传输
reason: 新意方法预印本，摘要未给出外部验证或大样本结果，属增量档
abstract: Automated tongue-sign recognition can improve the consistency of non-invasive examinations that otherwise rely on subjective visual judgment. A single tongue image often exhibits multiple coexisting signs characterized by heterogeneous evidence, including localized morphology, global chromaticity, and inter-label dependence. However, existing methods typically rely on shared representations and uniform multi-label heads, making it difficult to verify whether predictions stem from clinically relevant evidence rather than spurious visual correlations. We propose SEAT, an evidence-audited framework that matches distinct evidence types with dedicated prediction and evaluation mechanisms. Built on frozen DINOv2 patch features, SEAT couples mask-guided sign-specific attention for localized morphology, a semi-relaxed optimal transport pathway over LAB/HSV color prototypes to enhance pale-tongue recognition, and a co-occurrence-aware transport regularizer to shape the batch-level predicted label marginal. These components are evaluated through audits matched to their evidence types. On the TongueDx benchmark, SEAT achieves a mean macro-F1 of 72.59 with a standard deviation of 1.04 across six random seeds, with a six-model ensemble reaching 74.15. The ensemble outperforms a backbone-matched baseline and a larger, domain-specialized vision-language model by 8.06 and 2.99 percentage points, respectively. Our results demonstrate that aligning dedicated prediction pathways and audits with sign-specific characteristics improves multi-label accuracy while offering more targeted evidential grounding than uniform post-hoc spatial explanations. Code is available at https://github.com/NEU-TCM-Lab/Sign-type-Evidence-Audited-Transport.
zh_abstract: 自动舌象识别可提高非侵入性检查的一致性，否则这些检查依赖主观视觉判断。单张舌图像常表现出多种共存征象，其特征为异质性证据，包括局部形态、全局色度和标签间依赖。然而，现有方法通常依赖共享表示和统一的多标签头，难以验证预测是源于临床相关证据，还是源于虚假的视觉相关性。我们提出SEAT，一个证据审计框架，将不同证据类型与专门的预测和评估机制相匹配。SEAT基于冻结的DINOv2图像块特征，将用于局部形态的掩码引导征象特异性注意力、基于LAB/HSV颜色原型以增强淡白舌识别的半松弛最优传输路径，以及用于塑造批级预测标签边缘分布的共现感知传输正则化器耦合起来。这些组件通过与其证据类型匹配的审计进行评估。在TongueDx基准上，SEAT在六个随机种子上的平均macro-F1为72.59，标准差为1.04，六模型集成达到74.15。该集成分别比骨干网络匹配的基线和一个更大的领域专用视觉语言模型高出8.06和2.99个百分点。我们的结果表明，将专门的预测通路和审计与征象特异性特征对齐，可提高多标签准确率，同时提供比统一的事后空间解释更有针对性的证据基础。代码见 https://github.com/NEU-TCM-Lab/Sign-type-Evidence-Audited-Transport。

title: DBHiCo: Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning for MRI Image Classification
zh_title: DBHiCo：用于MRI分类的双分支层次对比学习
summary: 提出双分支层次对比学习框架，通过解剖多视角配对强化结构一致性与语义区分，用于MRI图像分类。
key_points: 针对采集噪声与个体间结构相似性问题
利用解剖多视角配对约束跨视角结构一致性
区分负样本异质性以提升细粒度判别
reason: 方法类预印本，仅描述框架与动机，未见数据规模与外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Automated Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) image classification provides a crucial non-invasive approach for neurological diagnosis, yet it is fundamentally challenged by inherent acquisition noise and high inter-subject structural similarity, which obscure subtle pathological variations, thereby limiting the performance of deep neural networks. While contrastive learning (CL) offers a promising mitigation strategy, existing paradigms rely on rigid binary partitions that ignore negative sample heterogeneity, and they fail to capture the cross-view structural consistency vital for fine-grained anatomical alignment. To address these barriers, we propose Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning (DBHiCo), a novel framework explicitly designed to collaboratively enforce structural consistency and semantic discrimination. Specifically, DBHiCo leverages a natural anatomical multi-view pair (original and skull-stripped MRI scans), processing them through a dual-branch architecture to seamlessly integrate holistic structural robustness with localized intracranial details. Crucially, we introduce a hierarchical contrastive loss that discards conventional binary constraints in favor of a margin-ranked similarity hierarchy. This mechanism explicitly orders positive and negative pairs based on their structural and semantic difficulty, thereby amplifying the fine-grained semantic discriminability of the learned representations. Extensive experiments across three diverse neurological datasets demonstrate that DBHiCo achieves state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming existing MRI multi-view representation learning and advanced contrastive fine-tuning methods.
zh_abstract: 自动化磁共振成像（Magnetic Resonance Imaging, MRI）图像分类为神经系统诊断提供了一种关键的无创途径，但其从根本上受到固有采集噪声和高受试者间结构相似性的制约，这些因素会掩盖细微的病理变化，从而限制深度神经网络的性能。尽管对比学习（contrastive learning, CL）提供了一种有前景的缓解策略，但现有范式依赖僵化的二元划分，忽略了负样本的异质性，且未能捕捉对细粒度解剖对齐至关重要的跨视角结构一致性。为解决这些障碍，我们提出双分支分层对比学习（Dual-Branch Hierarchical Contrastive Learning, DBHiCo），这是一个新颖的框架，明确设计用于协同地强化结构一致性与语义判别性。具体而言，DBHiCo 利用一对天然的解剖多视角图像（原始 MRI 扫描与剥除颅骨的 MRI 扫描），通过双分支架构对其进行处理，以无缝整合整体结构鲁棒性与局部颅内细节。关键在于，我们引入了一种分层对比损失，它摒弃传统的二元约束，转而采用基于间隔排序的相似性层级。该机制依据正负样本对的结构与语义难度对其进行显式排序，从而放大所学表征的细粒度语义判别能力。在三个不同的神经系统数据集上的大量实验表明，DBHiCo 达到了最先进的性能，持续优于现有的 MRI 多视角表征学习和先进的对比微调方法。

title: CONTEXT-PCa: Evaluating the role of clinical context in MRI-based AI for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer (study protocol)
zh_title: CONTEXT-PCa：临床上下文对MRI AI检出前列腺癌的影响（研究方案）
summary: 预印本研究方案：在固定权重的PI-CAI-2B影像模型上加入43项临床变量，评估其对显著前列腺癌诊断与泛化性的作用。
key_points: 队列含6022例双参数MRI、4540名患者
主要终点为影像+上下文与仅影像模型的AUROC差异
临床变量来自结构化病历、信件、MRI报告与自动测量
reason: 仅为研究方案、尚无结果，单中心回顾性设计，属增量档
abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate the role of clinical variables - their breadth, source, and quality - in the development, utility, and generalisability of an AI system for bi-parametric MRI (bpMRI)-based diagnosis of clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). Clinical context is added to the published PI-CAI-2B image-only model, whose weights are fixed. The study cohort comprises 6,022 biparametric MRI cases from 4,540 patients at University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (2019-2024), of which 4,834 cases (3,632 patients) are held out for internal testing. Forty-three clinical variables are drawn from structured health records, clinical letters, MRI reports, and automated image measurements. The primary endpoint is the difference in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) between the image-context and image-only models on the internal test set. Secondary analyses compare combining strategies, the contribution of individual variables, and performance across subgroups. All models are further tested on five external cohorts from primary diagnosis and population-based screening.
zh_abstract: 本研究的目的是探讨临床变量——其广度、来源和质量——在基于双参数MRI（bi-parametric MRI, bpMRI）诊断临床显著性前列腺癌（clinically significant prostate cancer, csPCa）的AI系统的开发、效用和泛化性中的作用。将临床背景信息加入已发表的PI-CAI-2B仅图像模型，该模型的权重固定。研究队列包括来自伦敦大学学院医院NHS基金会信托（University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust）4,540例患者的6,022例双参数MRI病例（2019-2024），其中4,834例（3,632例患者）被留出用于内部测试。43个临床变量取自结构化健康记录、临床信件、MRI报告和自动图像测量。主要终点是内部测试集上图像-背景（image-context）模型与仅图像（image-only）模型之间受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUROC）的差异。次要分析比较组合策略、单个变量的贡献以及各亚组间的性能。所有模型进一步在来自初诊和人群筛查的五个外部队列上进行测试。

title: From AI-Enabled Remote Patient Monitoring Toward Agentic Robotics: Embodiment, Governance, and Care Integration
zh_title: 从远程监测到具身智能体机器人：综述
summary: 结构化范围综述指出，具备自主决策-行动闭环的智能体照护尚未成熟，多数系统仍以人为主导，具身AI多停留于原型与试点，并提出互操作与治理要求。
key_points: 综述认为成熟的自主体照护尚未出现
决策-行动闭环与具身AI多在原型和试点阶段
强调具身、临床整合、人类监督与治理
reason: 预印本范围综述，无原始数据与结局评估，综述类最高6分，取增量档
abstract: AI-enabled remote patient monitoring is evolving beyond passive data collection toward agentic AI systems that interpret patient states, coordinate care, and initiate action across domestic and clinical settings. This structured scoping review finds that mature agentic care has not yet emerged: Most systems remain human led, while stronger decision-action coupling and embodied AI remain largely confined to prototypes and pilots. Healthcare robotics makes the transition from monitoring to action especially visible by translating AI-generated recommendations and decisions into speech, movement, prompting, physical assistance, escalation, and care coordination, making embodiment, clinical integration, human oversight, and governance fundamental design requirements. Further progress requires safe and interoperable care architectures in which intelligent components operate through clinically validated and accountable workflows. We propose agentic robotics as a future direction for supervised systems embedded in the care ecosystem, connecting AI agents and robots with clinicians, caregivers, and patients through auditable workflows that can be interrupted and remain subject to human oversight and explicit AI governance.
zh_abstract: 人工智能赋能的远程患者监测正从被动数据收集演进为能够解读患者状态、协调照护并在家庭和临床环境中启动行动的代理式人工智能（agentic AI）系统。这项结构化范围综述发现，成熟的代理式照护尚未出现：大多数系统仍由人类主导，而更强的决策-行动耦合和具身人工智能仍主要局限于原型和试点。医疗保健机器人通过将人工智能生成的建议和决策转化为言语、移动、提示、身体辅助、升级处置和照护协调，使从监测到行动的转变尤为明显，从而使具身性、临床整合、人类监督和治理成为基本设计要求。进一步进展需要安全且可互操作的照护架构，其中智能组件通过经临床验证且可问责的工作流程运行。我们提出代理式机器人学作为未来方向，即嵌入照护生态系统的受监督系统，通过可审计、可中断且仍受人类监督和明确人工智能治理约束的工作流程，将人工智能代理和机器人与临床医生、照护者和患者连接起来。

title: MemoryLane: Supporting Reminiscence Conversations Between Older Adults with Mild Dementia and Lay Caregivers Using a Simulated AI Agent
zh_title: MemoryLane：模拟AI同伴辅助轻度痴呆老人回忆对话
summary: 面向轻度痴呆老人与家属照护者的工具，通过模拟AI同伴与生成图像支持三方回忆对话。
key_points: 回忆疗法可改善情绪与心理状态，但照片整理负担大
照护者若缺乏共同经历，难以引导有效回忆对话
界面共享AI同伴与AI生成记忆图像，无需预先整理照片
reason: 预印本人机交互工具，规模与效果证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Reminiscence Therapy (RT) is a non-pharmacological intervention that invites patients to discuss and review past life experiences and memories to improve their emotional and mental well-being. In practice, many reminiscence conversations are led by lay caregivers, such as spouses and adult children. While traditional RT often relies on personal photographs, curating them can be tedious and difficult. In addition, caregivers who lack shared life experiences with the patient may struggle to facilitate engaging reminiscence conversations. This paper presents MemoryLane, an AI-integrated tool that helps lay caregivers facilitate reminiscence conversations without curated photographs. MemoryLane supports a triadic conversation among the patient, the caregiver, and a simulated AI agent that acts as the patient's peer. A shared interface shows the agent and AI-generated images of the memories being discussed, while a private smartphone interface lets the caregiver control the behavior of the simulated AI agent and moderate the AI-generated images. A preliminary focus group study with five dementia-care stakeholders suggested the value of MemoryLane's AI agent as a peer companion and of AI-generated images, as well as the feasibility of having caregivers moderate images and control the AI agent.
zh_abstract: 回忆疗法（Reminiscence Therapy, RT）是一种非药物干预，邀请患者讨论和回顾过去的生活经历与记忆，以改善其情绪和心理健康。在实践中，许多回忆对话由非专业照护者（如配偶和成年子女）主导。传统 RT 通常依赖个人照片，但整理这些照片可能繁琐且困难。此外，缺乏与患者共同生活经历的照护者可能难以促成引人投入的回忆对话。本文介绍 MemoryLane，一种集成 AI 的工具，帮助非专业照护者在没有整理好的照片的情况下促进回忆对话。MemoryLane 支持患者、照护者以及一个模拟 AI 代理（agent）之间的三元对话，该代理充当患者的同伴。共享界面显示该代理和所讨论记忆的 AI 生成图像，而私人智能手机界面让照护者控制模拟 AI 代理的行为并审核 AI 生成图像。一项与五名痴呆症照护利益相关者的初步焦点小组研究表明，MemoryLane 的 AI 代理作为同伴陪伴以及 AI 生成图像具有价值，并且照护者审核图像和控制 AI 代理具有可行性。

title: Scaling Channel-Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning
zh_title: 通道自适应自监督学习的规模化研究
summary: 在含医学影像的非RGB科学成像上大规模训练，发现独立编码各通道的通道自适应策略表现更优。
key_points: 关注多数据集通道数量与语义不一致问题
大规模训练下独立通道编码优于联合编码
面向生物、医学与卫星等科学成像领域
reason: 方法学预印本，医学影像仅为应用领域之一，属增量档
abstract: Recent advances in self-supervised pre-training of foundation models for natural images have made them a popular choice for various visual systems and applications. Self-supervised strategies are also promising in non-RGB scientific imaging domains such as in biology, medical and satellite imagery, but their broader application is hampered by heterogeneity in channel composition and semantics between relevant datasets: two datasets may contain different numbers of channels, and these may reveal distinct aspects of an object or scene. Recent works on channel adaptive strategies report substantial advantages for those that account for variable channel compositions without sacrificing the ability to jointly encode channels; yet, how these strategies behave at scale remains unclear. We here show that, surprisingly, trained across large-scale datasets, independent-encoding of channels outperforms joint-encoding methods by a substantial margin. We validate this result along an extensive set of experiments on various datasets from cell microscopy to geospatial imagery. Our DINO BoC approach sets a new state-of-the-art across challenging benchmarks, including generalization to out-of-distribution tasks and unseen channel combinations. We open-source code and model weights for a new general-purpose feature extractor for fluorescent microscopy.
zh_abstract: 自然图像基础模型自监督预训练的最新进展，使其成为各种视觉系统和应用的热门选择。自监督策略在非 RGB 科学成像领域（如生物学、医学和卫星影像）同样具有前景，但其更广泛的应用受到相关数据集之间通道组成与语义异质性的阻碍：两个数据集可能包含不同数量的通道，而这些通道可能揭示对象或场景的不同方面。近期关于通道自适应策略的工作报告称，那些在不牺牲联合编码通道能力的前提下考虑可变通道组成的策略具有显著优势；然而，这些策略在大规模下的表现仍不清楚。我们在此表明，令人惊讶的是，在大规模数据集上训练时，通道的独立编码以显著幅度优于联合编码方法。我们通过从细胞显微成像到地理空间影像的各类数据集上的一系列广泛实验验证了这一结果。我们的 DINO BoC 方法在具有挑战性的基准上创下新的最先进水平，包括对分布外任务和未见通道组合的泛化。我们开源了一个用于荧光显微成像的新型通用特征提取器的代码和模型权重。

title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
zh_title: 单通道脑电可解释睡眠分期分类
summary: 扩展SleepXAI框架系统比较五种XAI方法，并用与AASM频段的秩相关评估归因保真度，在Sleep-EDF与DREAMT上实验。
key_points: 比较五种可解释性方法
以AASM频段为临床参照评估归因保真度
DREAMT按AHI分层为四组分析
reason: 公开数据集上的可解释性比较，无外部临床验证与结局，属增量档
abstract: Automated sleep staging has achieved strong bench- mark accuracy; however, clinical adoption remains limited due to a lack of interpretability. In this work, we fill the research gap by extending the SleepXAI sleep staging framework to systematically compare five different XAI methods. Further, attribution fidelity is evaluated using Spearman rank correlation with AASM-defined EEG frequency bands, serving as clinically grounded reference signals. In this paper, we focus on single- channel Electroencephalogram (EEG), which is more amenable to practical clinical deployment compared to full polysomnography setups. Experiments are conducted on the Sleep-EDF benchmark dataset and the DREAMT dataset. In DREAMT, we stratified subjects based on OSA into four Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) severity groups. We observed that the SleepXAI model achieves strong classification performance on both datasets. Among the evaluated methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) consistently achieves the highest mean attribution fidelity across all five sleep stages on Sleep-EDF and across all AHI groups on DREAMT, outperforming all other evaluated methods under the Spearman rank correlation metric. These findings highlight the importance of attribution method selection as a key factor for ensuring reliable and clinically interpretable automated sleep staging systems.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期已取得很强的基准准确率；然而，由于缺乏可解释性，临床采用仍然有限。在本工作中，我们通过扩展 SleepXAI 睡眠分期框架来系统比较五种不同的 XAI 方法，从而填补这一研究空白。此外，归因保真度通过 Spearman 秩相关与 AASM 定义的 EEG 频带进行评估，这些频带作为具有临床依据的参考信号。在本文中，我们关注单通道脑电图（EEG），与完整多导睡眠图设置相比，它更适合实际临床部署。实验在 Sleep-EDF 基准数据集和 DREAMT 数据集上进行。在 DREAMT 中，我们根据 OSA 将受试者分层为四个呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）严重程度组。我们观察到，SleepXAI 模型在两个数据集上均取得很强的分类性能。在评估的方法中，Integrated Gradients（IG）在 Sleep-EDF 的所有五个睡眠阶段以及 DREAMT 的所有 AHI 组中始终取得最高的平均归因保真度，在 Spearman 秩相关指标下优于所有其他评估方法。这些发现强调了归因方法选择作为确保可靠且具有临床可解释性的自动睡眠分期系统的关键因素的重要性。

title: MamaReason: Unfinished Reasoning and Answer Recovery in Clinical Language Models
zh_title: MamaReason：临床语言模型的未完成推理与答案恢复
summary: 预印本在 217 组母婴健康病例上分析临床语言模型未完成推理时已给出的诊断，并考察续写与直接读取承诺的差异。
key_points: 显式承诺提取器在多数失败首轮中识别出诊断
续写多与已给出的诊断一致
分解出轨迹中已存在的诊断内容与后续生成贡献
reason: 分析对象仅 217 组病例、结论偏机制性，属增量档
abstract: Answer continuation often returns a diagnosis already stated in unfinished clinical reasoning. We study this behavior in MamaReason, adapted from dense Gemma 4 31B, on MamaBench's 217 paired maternal and child-health presentations. An explicit-commitment extractor identifies a diagnosis in 75 of 94 failed RL first passes and 75 of 93 failed SFT first passes. The continuation matches that diagnosis in 67/75 RL cases and 58/75 SFT cases, using diagnosis strings alone. Reading these commitments without additional generation recovers 30 of the 40 RL pairs restored by continuation under the archived correctness labels. Recurrence controls distinguish routine mentions from repeated answer selection. An offline second-commitment trigger measures the tradeoff between earlier readout and paired accuracy. The resulting decomposition separates diagnostic content already present in a trace, completion of an accepted answer, and paired diagnostic correctness. For clinical language-model evaluation, these are distinct outcomes that become visible when the same reasoning trace is examined through multiple readouts.
zh_abstract: 答案续写常常返回一个已在未完成的临床推理中陈述的诊断。我们在 MamaReason 中研究这种行为，该模型改编自稠密 Gemma 4 31B，并在 MamaBench 的 217 个配对的母婴健康就诊表现上进行研究。一个显式承诺提取器在 94 个失败的强化学习首轮尝试中识别出 75 个诊断，在 93 个失败的监督微调首轮尝试中识别出 75 个诊断。仅使用诊断字符串，续写在 67/75 个强化学习病例和 58/75 个监督微调病例中与该诊断匹配。在不进行额外生成的情况下读取这些承诺，可在存档的正确性标签下恢复由续写所恢复的 40 个强化学习对中的 30 个。重复性控制将常规提及与重复答案选择区分开来。离线第二承诺触发器衡量更早读出与配对准确性之间的权衡。所得分解将推理轨迹中已存在的诊断内容、已接受答案的完成以及配对诊断正确性区分开来。对于临床语言模型评估，当通过多种读出方式检查同一推理轨迹时，这些是变得可见的不同结果。

title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
zh_title: 脑肿瘤分割的交互式深度学习界面
summary: 提出一套默认全自动、但允许用户交互纠正的脑肿瘤MR分割系统，以应对不同MR序列造成的严重分割错误，并报告界面评估结果。
key_points: 默认全自动分割，用户可交互纠正
针对跨厂商MR序列差异导致的严重分割失败
摘要未披露样本量与验证方式
reason: 预印本方法类工作，无外部验证或大样本信息，属增量档
abstract: Brain tumour segmentation from MR images is an integral part of their treatment, either through surgical resection or radiotherapy. Both applications require a high degree of precision that can be difficult to ensure for all patients due to the high degree of variability in the size, shape, number, and location of these tumours. This leads to difficulties with their automatic segmentation via deep learning, which can display catastrophic segmentation errors when presented with images that differ, even subtly, in terms of the specific MR sequence used, which varies from vendor to vendor. This article presents a deep-learning-based interactive segmentation system that, while being fully automatic by default, has the capability of being easily corrected by human users, allowing them ensure sufficiently high brain tumour segmentation accuracy for all patients. This interface is evaluated both in terms of the accuracy of its automatic approach as well as its usability through a preliminary observational expert user study.
zh_abstract: 基于MR图像的脑肿瘤分割是其治疗（无论是手术切除还是放疗）不可或缺的组成部分。这两种应用都需要高度精确，而由于这些肿瘤在大小、形状、数量和位置上具有高度变异性，可能难以对所有患者确保这一点。这导致通过深度学习对其进行自动分割存在困难；当面对因所用特定MR序列（不同厂商有所不同）而存在差异（即使差异细微）的图像时，深度学习可能出现灾难性分割错误。本文提出一种基于深度学习的交互式分割系统，该系统默认完全自动，但可由人类用户轻松校正，从而使其能够确保对所有患者达到足够高的脑肿瘤分割准确率。该界面通过一项初步观察性专家用户研究，既评估其自动方法的准确性，也评估其可用性。

title: CardioTrace: Motion-Aware Cine Synthesis via Coupled Tracing and Segmentation
zh_title: CardioTrace：运动感知的心脏电影序列合成
summary: 从有限输入生成完整心脏电影MRI序列，耦合像素平移与流场双分支显式追踪心肌运动，并加入分割分支约束解剖合理性。
key_points: 由稀疏输入合成完整心脏电影序列
像素平移与流场双分支显式建模运动
分割分支约束解剖合理性
reason: 生成式影像方法预印本，摘要未给外部验证或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Cardiac cine MRI provides time-resolved visualization of cardiac motion and is essential for evaluating ventricular function and anatomy. In routine clinical acquisition, however, cine sequences are frequently temporally sparse or degraded by arrhythmia, motion, and scan-time constraints, which can hinder reliable quantification and downstream analysis. We present CardioTrace, a motion-aware cine synthesis framework that generates a full cardiac cine sequence from limited input while explicitly modeling and tracing cardiac motion. CardioTrace couples two complementary pathways: a pixel-translation branch that directly predicts cine frames in a residual formulation, and a flow-field branch that estimates time-resolved deformation fields from a reference phase to provide interpretable motion correspondences across frames. To further preserve anatomical plausibility, a segmentation branch supervises clinically meaningful cardiac structures at key phases, and a cross-branch consistency objective encourages the synthesized appearance dynamics to follow the explicit motion guidance, mitigating temporal drift and unrealistic shape transitions over long sequences. The framework also supports prompt-style conditioning to incorporate auxiliary patient or acquisition information, improving robustness across heterogeneous multi-center data. Experiments on public cardiac cine MRI datasets demonstrate that CardioTrace improves perceptual quality and temporal coherence over representative GAN- and diffusion-based baselines, while better preserving ventricular morphology throughout the cardiac cycle. \textit{Our codes are available after review}.
zh_abstract: 心脏电影MRI提供心脏运动的时间分辨可视化，对于评估心室功能和解剖结构至关重要。然而，在常规临床采集中，电影序列常常在时间上稀疏，或因心律失常、运动以及扫描时间限制而退化，这可能妨碍可靠量化和下游分析。我们提出CardioTrace，一种运动感知的电影合成框架，可从有限输入生成完整的心脏电影序列，同时显式建模并追踪心脏运动。CardioTrace结合两条互补路径：一条像素平移分支，以残差形式直接预测电影帧；以及一条流场分支，从参考相位估计时间分辨的形变场，以提供跨帧的可解释运动对应关系。为进一步保持解剖合理性，一个分割分支在关键相位监督具有临床意义的心脏结构，而跨分支一致性目标鼓励合成的外观动态遵循显式运动引导，从而减轻长序列中的时间漂移和不真实形状转变。该框架还支持提示风格的条件化，以纳入辅助的患者或采集信息，提高在异质多中心数据上的稳健性。在公共心脏电影MRI数据集上的实验表明，CardioTrace相较于代表性的基于GAN和基于扩散的基线，提高了感知质量和时间一致性，同时在整个心动周期中更好地保持心室形态。我们的代码将在评审后提供。

abstract: [Healthcare (Basel, Switzerland)] This study examined knowledge, attitudes, comfort, perceived usefulness, and institutional context regarding artificial intelligence (AI) among speech-language pathology (SLP) students and clinicians in Saudi Arabia. This exploratory cross-sectional online survey used a questionnaire informed by Austin et al. and was distributed through snowball sampling. Data from 122 participants (75 students, 16 interns, and 31 practicing clinicians) were analyzed. Groups were compared using Kruskal-Wallis tests with Holm correction and linear regression with HC3-robust standard errors adjusted for gender and frequency of ChatGPT use. The majority (97.5%) of the participants had used ChatGPT, and 77% used it three or more times per week, yet self-rated knowledge was moderate. Comfort with AI was moderate to high, and concern about AI replacing SLPs was low to moderate. The participants were uncertain about AI's ability to administer and analyze assessments and rated administrative tasks as its most useful application. After Holm correction, only perceived usefulness differed across the three group comparisons, with interns rating it higher than students. Across 16 adjusted group comparisons, only perceived student academic use was rated higher by interns than by students. No group differences were significant among participants aged 18-24 years. Most participants (70.5%) reported having no institutional AI guidelines. Participants used AI frequently and held generally positive but cautious views, with few group differences. These findings support AI literacy training in SLP curricula and SLP-specific guidelines for responsible AI use.

title: Dynamic infrared thermography and computed tomography angiography fusion for DIEP flap perforator selection: a novel measurement system

summary: 构建动态红外热成像与CTA穿支坐标自动融合的标准化测量系统，在12例患者中感兴趣区内46个CTA穿支有84.8%成功匹配。
key_points: DIRT提供灌注信息，CTA提供解剖定位

reason: 单中心12例小样本，仅报告配准成功率，属增量档
abstract: Accurate perforator selection is critical for successful deep inferior epigastric artery perforator (DIEP) flap breast reconstruction. While computed tomography angiography (CTA) provides high-resolution anatomical detail, it lacks functional perfusion assessment. Dynamic infrared thermography (DIRT), in contrast, captures superficial rewarming dynamics but lacks objective anatomical validation. This study presents a standardized multimodal measurement system enabling automated fusion of DIRT with CTA-derived perforator coordinates. The framework integrates controlled thermographic acquisition, real-time hotspot detection, metric spatial calibration, and global one-to-one assignment of thermal hotspots to CTA perforators within a predefined periumbilical region of interest. The workflow was evaluated in 12 patients. Of 46 CTA perforators within the region of interest, 84.8% were successfully linked to thermographic hotspots, with a median spatial offset of 14.74 mm. Automated assignment excluded 76.1% of detected hotspots due to lack of anatomical correspondence, thereby reducing subjective interpretation. The proposed system enables quantitative multimodal validation of functional and anatomical imaging and provides objective support for perforator selection in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 准确的穿支选择对于腹壁下深动脉穿支（deep inferior epigastric artery perforator, DIEP）皮瓣乳房重建的成功至关重要。计算机断层扫描血管成像（computed tomography angiography, CTA）虽可提供高分辨率解剖细节，但缺乏功能性灌注评估。相比之下，动态红外热成像（dynamic infrared thermography, DIRT）可捕捉浅表复温动态，但缺乏客观的解剖学验证。本研究提出一种标准化多模态测量系统，可实现DIRT与CTA衍生的穿支坐标的自动融合。该框架整合了受控热成像采集、实时热点检测、度量空间校准，以及在预定义脐周感兴趣区内将热成像热点全局一对一分配至CTA穿支。该工作流程在12名患者中进行了评估。在感兴趣区内的46个CTA穿支中，84.8%成功与热成像热点建立关联，中位空间偏移为14.74 mm。自动分配因缺乏解剖学对应关系而排除了76.1%的检测到的热点，从而减少了主观判读。所提出的系统能够对功能性和解剖性成像进行定量多模态验证，并为临床实践中的穿支选择提供客观支持。

key_points: 合成28×28数字图像：中等噪声下先验优于有界TV约3.4 dB
MNIST训练先验在Fashion-MNIST与体模上低于TV 3.1–4.6 dB
另设病灶插入实验考察病灶可检测性
reason: 以合成与体模图像为主、无临床数据，属方法对比的增量研究
abstract: Learned image priors are often proposed to replace hand-crafted regularizers in sparse-view computed tomography (CT), yet they are usually judged by PSNR on data resembling their training set. We evaluate one noise-conditioned DnCNN denoiser used as a Plug-and-Play prior against filtered back-projection (FBP), Tikhonov and total-variation (TV) regularization, with every method tuned on validation data and all differences paired. On synthetic 28x28 digit images, the prior beats box-constrained TV by about 3.4 dB at moderate noise (sigma = 0.05, 20 angles), but the advantage shrinks at low noise and reverses under distribution shift: an MNIST-trained prior is 3.1 dB (Fashion-MNIST) and 4.3-4.6 dB (Shepp-Logan phantom) below TV, whereas a Fashion-MNIST-trained prior beats TV by 2.2 dB on Fashion-MNIST, consistent with prior mismatch rather than a failure of PnP itself. In a lesion-insertion test the prior detects lesions worse than TV in distribution despite its higher PSNR, and under mismatch it produces more lesion-like false blobs than box-constrained TV for seven of eight lesion types. On real LoDoPaB-CT slices (patient-disjoint split; 30, 60 and 120 angles; three dose levels; 40 test patients), the prior does not consistently outperform a well-tuned TV in PSNR (-0.93 to +0.33 dB) and has lower SSIM in eight of nine conditions. Its lesion-detection AUC is higher than this TV's in all nine conditions (significant in six) but never significantly higher than that of Hann-filtered FBP, which the PSNR-tuned TV falls below in detection in all nine conditions (seven significant). On non-anatomical phantoms its PSNR falls below TV in all six conditions. PSNR and lesion detectability thus rank the methods differently. Our conclusions concern one small denoiser, and the CT analysis was developed after seeing results, without pre-specified primary comparisons.
zh_abstract: 在稀疏视角计算机断层扫描（CT）中，学习到的图像先验常被提出用于替代手工设计的正则化器，但它们通常依据与训练集相似数据上的PSNR来评判。我们将一个噪声条件化DnCNN去噪器用作即插即用先验，并与滤波反投影（FBP）、Tikhonov和全变差（TV）正则化进行比较；每种方法均在验证数据上调参，所有差异均按配对方式处理。在合成的28x28数字图像上，该先验在中等噪声（sigma = 0.05，20个角度）下比箱约束TV高约3.4 dB，但其优势在低噪声下缩小，并在分布偏移下反转：在MNIST上训练的先验比TV低3.1 dB（Fashion-MNIST）和4.3-4.6 dB（Shepp-Logan体模），而在Fashion-MNIST上训练的先验在Fashion-MNIST上比TV高2.2 dB，这与先验失配一致，而不是PnP本身失效。在病灶插入测试中，该先验尽管PSNR更高，但在分布内检测病灶不如TV；在失配情况下，对于八种病灶类型中的七种，它比箱约束TV产生更多类似病灶的假团块。在真实LoDoPaB-CT切片上（患者不重叠划分；30、60和120个角度；三个剂量水平；40例测试患者），该先验在PSNR上并未始终优于调参良好的TV（-0.93至+0.33 dB），并在九种情况中的八种具有较低的SSIM。其病灶检测AUC在全部九种情况下均高于该TV（其中六种显著），但从未显著高于Hann滤波FBP的AUC；而经PSNR调参的TV在全部九种情况下检测均低于Hann滤波FBP（其中七种显著）。在非解剖体模上，其PSNR在全部六种情况下均低于TV。因此，PSNR和病灶可检测性对这些方法的排序不同。我们的结论仅涉及一个小型去噪器，且CT分析是在看到结果后开发的，没有预先设定的主要比较。
